verses.translit: Wallazeena yaqooloona Rabbanas rif 'annnaa 'azaaba Jahannama inn 'azaabahaa kaana gharaamaa
verses.translation: And who say: Our Lord! Avert from us the doom of hell; lo! the doom thereof is anguish;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا
verses.translit: Innahaa saaa'at mustaqarranw wa muqaamaa
verses.translation: Lo! it is wretched as abode and station;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًۭا
verses.translit: Wallazeena izaaa anfaqoo lam yusrifoo wa lam yaqturoo wa kaana baina zaalika qawaamaa
verses.translation: And those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal nor grudging; and there is ever a firm station between the two;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًۭا
verses.translit: Wallazeena laa yad'oona ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara wa laa yaqtuloonan nafsal latee harramal laahu illaa bilhaqqi wa laa yaznoon; wa mai yaf'al zaalika yalqa asaamaa
verses.translation: And those who cry not unto any other god along with Allah, nor take the life which Allah hath forbidden save in (course of) justice, nor commit adultery - and whoso doeth this shall pay the penalty;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يُضَٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا
verses.translit: Yudaa'af lahul 'azaabu Yawmal Qiyaamati wa yakhlud feehee muhaanaa
verses.translation: The doom will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein disdained for ever;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًۭا صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَٰتٍۢ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا
verses.translit: Illaa man taaba wa 'aamana wa 'amila 'amalan saalihan fa ulaaa'ika yubad dilul laahu saiyi aatihim hasanaat; wa kaanal laahu Ghafoorar Raheemaa
verses.translation: Save him who repenteth and believeth and doth righteous work; as for such, Allah will change their evil deeds to good deeds. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًۭا
verses.translit: Wa man taaba wa 'amila saalihan fa innnahoo yatoobu ilal laahi mataabaa
verses.translation: And whosoever repenteth and doeth good, he verily repenteth toward Allah with true repentance -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًۭا
verses.translit: Wallazeena laa yash hadoonaz zoora wa izaa marroo billaghwi marroo kiraamaa
verses.translation: And those who will not witness vanity, but when they pass near senseless play, pass by with dignity.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّۭا وَعُمْيَانًۭا
verses.translit: Wallazeena izaa zukkiroo bi Aayaati Rabbihim lam yakhirroo 'alaihaa summanw wa'umyaanaa
verses.translation: And those who, when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍۢ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
verses.translit: Wallazeena yaqooloona Rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa zurriyaatinaa qurrata a'yuninw waj 'alnaa lilmuttaqeena Imaamaa
verses.translation: And who say: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةًۭ وَسَلَٰمًا
verses.translit: Ulaaa'ika yujzawnal ghurfata bimaa sabaroo wa yulaqqawna feehaa tahiyyatanw wa salaamaa
verses.translation: They will be awarded the high place forasmuch as they were steadfast, and they will meet therein with welcome and the ward of peace,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا
verses.translit: Khaalideena feehaa; hasunat mustaqarranw wa muqaamaa
verses.translation: Abiding there for ever. Happy is it as abode and station!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا
verses.translit: Qul maa ya'ba'u bikum Rabbee law laa du'aaa'ukum faqad kazzabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaamaa
verses.translation: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): My Lord would not concern Himself with you but for your prayer. But now ye have denied (the Truth), therefor there will be judgment.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ طسٓمٓ
verses.translit: Taa-Seeen-Meeem
verses.translation: Ta. Sin. Mim.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.translit: Tilka Aayaatul Kitaabil Mubeen
verses.translation: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: La'allaka baakhi'un nafsaka allaa yakoonoo mu'mineen
verses.translation: It may be that thou tormentest thyself (O Muhammad) because they believe not.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةًۭ فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
verses.translit: In nashaa nunazzil 'alaihim minas samaaa'i Aayatan fazallat a'naaquhum lahaa khaadi'een
verses.translation: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.translit: Wa maa yaateehim min zikrim minar Rahmaani muhdasin illaa kaanoo 'anhu mu'rideen
verses.translation: Never cometh there unto them a fresh reminder from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.translit: Faqad kazzaboo fasa yaateehim ambaaa'u maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
verses.translation: Now they have denied (the Truth); but there will come unto them tidings of that whereat they used to scoff.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
verses.translit: Awa lam yaraw ilal ardi kam ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjin kareem
verses.translation: Have they not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Inn fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
verses.translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translit: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
verses.translation: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.translit: Wa iz naadaa Rabbuka Moosaaa ani'-til qawmaz zaalimeen
verses.translation: And when thy Lord called Moses, saying: Go unto the wrongdoing folk,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ
verses.translit: Qawma Fir'awn; alaa yattaqoon
verses.translation: The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
verses.translit: Qaala Rabbi inneee akhaafu ai yukazziboon
verses.translation: He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa yadeequ sadree wa laa yantaliqu lisaanee fa arsil ilaa Haaroon
verses.translation: And I shall be embarrassed, and my tongue will not speak plainly, therefor send for Aaron (to help me).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌۭ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
verses.translit: Wa lahum 'alaiya zambun fa akhaafu ai yaqtuloon
verses.translation: And they have a crime against me, so I fear that they will kill me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
verses.translit: Qaala kallaa fazhabaa bi Aayaatinaaa innaa ma'akum mustami'oon
verses.translation: He said: Nay, verily. So go ye twain with Our tokens. Lo! We shall be with you, Hearing.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Faatiyaa Fir'awna faqoolaaa innaa Rasoolu Rabbil 'aalameen
verses.translation: And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.translit: An arsil ma'anaa Baneee Israaa'eel
verses.translation: (Saying): Let the Children of Israel go with us.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًۭا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
verses.translit: Qaala alam nurabbika feenaa waleedanw wa labista feenaa min 'umurika sineen
verses.translation: (Pharaoh) said (unto Moses): Did we not rear thee among us as a child? And thou didst dwell many years of thy life among us,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.translit: Wa fa'alta fa'latakal latee fa'alta wa anta minal kaafireen
verses.translation: And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst, and thou wast one of the ingrates.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًۭا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.translit: Qaala fa'altuhaaa izanw wa ana minad daaaleen
verses.translation: He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًۭا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.translit: Fafarartu minkum lam maa khiftukum fawahaba lee Rabbee hukmanw wa ja'alanee minal mursaleen
verses.translation: Then I fled from you when I feared you, and my Lord vouchsafed me a command and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌۭ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.translit: Wa tilka ni'matun tamun nuhaa 'alaiya an 'abbatta Baneee Israaa'eel
verses.translation: And this is the past favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Qaala Fir'awnu wa maa Rabbul 'aalameen
verses.translation: Pharaoh said: And what is the Lord of the Worlds?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.translit: Qaala Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa in kuntum mooqineen
verses.translation: (Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye had but sure belief.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ
verses.translit: Qaala liman hawlahooo alaa tastami'oon
verses.translation: (Pharaoh) said unto those around him: Hear ye not?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translit: Qaala Rabbukum wa Rabbu aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen
verses.translation: He said: Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
verses.translit: Qaala inna Rasoolakumul lazee ursila ilaikum lamajnoon
verses.translation: (Pharaoh) said: Lo! your messenger who hath been sent unto you is indeed a madman!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.translit: Qaala Rabbul mashriqi wal maghribi wa maa baina humaa in kuntum ta'qiloon
verses.translation: He said: Lord of the East and the West and all that is between them, if ye did but understand.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
verses.translit: Qaala la'init takhazta ilaahan ghairee la aj'alannaka minal masjooneen
verses.translation: (Pharaoh) said: If thou choosest a god other than me, I assuredly shall place thee among the prisoners.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Qaala awalw ji'tuka bishai'im mubeen
verses.translation: He said: Even though I show thee something plain?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.translit: Qaala faati biheee in kunta minas saadiqeen
verses.translation: (Pharaoh) said: Produce it then, if thou art of the truthful!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Fa alqaa 'asaahu fa izaaa hiya su'baanum mubeen
verses.translation: Then he flung down his staff and it became a serpent manifest,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
verses.translit: Wa naza'a yadahoo faizaa hiya baidaaa'u linnaa zireen
verses.translation: And he drew forth his hand and lo! it was white to the beholders.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Qaala lilmala-i hawlahooo inna haazaa lasaahirun 'aleem
verses.translation: (Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo! this is verily a knowing wizard,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
verses.translit: Yureedu ai yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihee famaazaa taamuroon
verses.translation: Who would drive you out of your land by his magic. Now what counsel ye?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
verses.translit: Qaalooo arjih wa akhaahu wab'as filmadaaa'ini haashireen
verses.translation: They said: Put him off, (him) and his brother, and send into the cities summoners
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Yaatooka bikulli sah haarin 'aleem
verses.translation: Who shall bring unto thee every knowing wizard.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
verses.translit: Fa jumi'as saharatu limeeqaati Yawmim ma'loom
verses.translation: So the wizards were gathered together at a set time on a day appointed.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
verses.translit: Wa qeela linnaasi hal antum mujtami'oon
verses.translation: And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
verses.translit: La'allanaa nattabi'us saharata in kaanoo humul ghaalibeen
verses.translation: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards if they are the winners.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
verses.translit: Falammaa jaaa'as saharatu qaaloo li Fir'awna a'inna lanaa la ajjran in kunnaa nahnul ghaalibeen
verses.translation: And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.translit: Qaala na'am wa innakum izal laminal muqarrabeen
verses.translation: He said: Aye, and ye will then surely be of those brought near (to me).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
verses.translit: Qaala lahum Moosaaa alqoo maaa antum mulqoon
verses.translation: Moses said unto them: Throw what ye are going to throw!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
verses.translit: Fa alqaw hibaalahum wa 'isiyyahum wa qaaloo bi'izzati Fir'awna innaa lanahnul ghaaliboon
verses.translation: Then they threw down their cords and their staves and said: By Pharaoh's might, lo! we verily are the winners.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
verses.translit: Fa alqaa Moosaa 'asaahu fa izaa hiya talqafu maa yaafikoon
verses.translation: Then Moses threw his staff and lo! it swallowed that which they did falsely show.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَٰجِدِينَ
verses.translit: Fa ulqiyas saharatu saajideen
verses.translation: And the wizards were flung prostrate,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Qaalooo aamannaa bi Rabbil 'aalameen
verses.translation: Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
verses.translit: Rabbi Moosaa wa Haaroon
verses.translation: The Lord of Moses and Aaron.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.translit: Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aazana lakum innahoo lakabeerukumul lazee 'alla makumus sihra falasawfa ta'lamoon; la uqatti'anna aidiyakum wa arjulakum min khilaafinw wa la usallibanna kum ajma'een
verses.translation: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put your faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he doubtless is your chief who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know. Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and verily I will crucify you every one.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
verses.translit: Qaaloo la daira innaaa ilaa Rabbinaa munqalliboon
verses.translation: They said: It is no hurt, for lo! unto our Lord we shall return.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Innaa natma'u ai yaghfira lanaa Rabbunna khataa yaanaaa an kunnaaa awwalal mu'mineen
verses.translation: Lo! we ardently hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we are the first of the believers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.translit: Wa awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa an asri bi'ibaadeee innakum muttaba'oon
verses.translation: And We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night, for ye will be pursued.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
verses.translit: Fa arsala Fir'awnu filmadaaa'ini haashireen
verses.translation: Then Pharaoh sent into the cities summoners,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌۭ قَلِيلُونَ
verses.translit: Inna haaa'ulaaa'i lashir zimatun qaleeloon
verses.translation: (Who said): Lo! these indeed are but a little troop,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
verses.translit: Wa innahum lanaa laghaaa'izoon
verses.translation: And lo! they are offenders against us.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَٰذِرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa innaa lajamee'un haaziroon
verses.translation: And lo! we are a ready host.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَخْرَجْنَٰهُم مِّن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
verses.translit: Fa akhrajnaahum min Jannaatinw wa 'uyoon
verses.translation: Thus did We take them away from gardens and watersprings,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَكُنُوزٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa kunoozinw wa ma qaamin kareem
verses.translation: And treasures and a fair estate.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.translit: Kazaalika wa awrasnaahaa Baneee Israaa'eel
verses.translation: Thus (were those things taken from them) and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
verses.translit: Fa atba'oohum mushriqeen
verses.translation: And they overtook them at sunrise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
verses.translit: Falammaa taraaa'al jam'aani qaala as haabu Moosaaa innaa lamudrakoon
verses.translation: And when the two hosts saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.translit: Qaala kallaaa inna ma'iya Rabbee sa yahdeen
verses.translation: He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.translit: Fa awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa anidrib bi'asaakal bahra fanfalaqa fakaana kullu firqin kattawdil 'azeem
verses.translation: Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And it parted, and each part was as a mountain vast.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
verses.translit: Wa azlafnaa sammal aakhareen
verses.translation: Then brought We near the others to that place.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.translit: Wa anjainaa Moosaa wa mam ma'ahooo ajma'een
verses.translation: And We saved Moses and those with him, every one;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
verses.translit: Summa aghraqnal aakhareen
verses.translation: And We drowned the others.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaah; wa maa kaana aksaru hu mu'mineen
verses.translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translit: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
verses.translation: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.translit: Watlu 'alaihim naba-a Ibraaheem
verses.translation: Recite unto them the story of Abraham:
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.translit: Iz qaala li abeehi wa qawmihee maa ta'budoon
verses.translation: When he said unto his father and his folk: What worship ye?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًۭا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
verses.translit: Qaaloo na'budu asnaaman fanazallu lahaa 'aakifeen
verses.translation: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
verses.translit: Qaala hal yasma'oona kum iz tad'oon
verses.translation: He said: Do they hear you when ye cry?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
verses.translit: Aw yanfa'oonakum aw yadurroon
verses.translation: Or do they benefit or harm you?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.translit: Qaaloo bal wajadnaaa aabaaa 'anaa kazaalika yaf'aloon
verses.translation: They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this wise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.translit: Qaala afara 'aitum maa kuntum ta'budoon
verses.translation: He said: See now that which ye worship,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
verses.translit: Antum wa aabaaa'ukumul aqdamoon
verses.translation: Ye and your forefathers!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Fa innahum 'aduwwwul leee illaa Rabbal 'aalameen
verses.translation: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me, save the Lord of the Worlds,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
verses.translit: Allazee khalaqanee fa Huwa yahdeen
verses.translation: Who created me, and He doth guide me,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
verses.translit: Wallazee Huwa yut'imunee wa yasqeen
verses.translation: And Who feedeth me and watereth me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
verses.translit: Wa izaa mardtu fahuwa yashfeen
verses.translation: And when I sicken, then He healeth me,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
verses.translit: Wallazee yumeetunee summa yuhyeen
verses.translation: And Who causeth me to die, then giveth me life (again),
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.translit: Wallazeee atma'u ai yaghfira lee khateee' atee Yawmad Deen
verses.translation: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.translit: Rabbi hab lee hukmanw wa alhiqnee bis saaliheen
verses.translation: My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verses.translit: Waj'al lee lisaana sidqin fil aakhireen
verses.translation: And give unto me a good report in later generations.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.translit: Waj'alnee minw warasati Jannnatin Na'eem
verses.translation: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.translit: Waghfir li abeee innahoo kaana mind daalleen
verses.translation: And forgive my father. Lo! he is of those who err.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.translit: Wa laa tukhzinee Yawma yub'asoon
verses.translation: And abase me not on the day when they are raised,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ
verses.translit: Yawma laa yanfa'u maalunw wa laa banoon
verses.translation: The day when wealth and sons avail not (any man)
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Illaa man atal laaha biqalbin saleem
verses.translation: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.translit: Wa uzlifatil Jannatu lilmuttaqeen
verses.translation: And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
verses.translit: Wa burrizatil Jaheemu lilghaaween
verses.translation: And hell will appear plainly to the erring.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.translit: Wa qeela lahum aina maa kuntum ta'budoon
verses.translation: And it will be said unto them: Where is (all) that ye used to worship
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
verses.translit: Min doonil laahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroon
verses.translation: Instead of Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
verses.translit: Fakubkiboo feehaa hum walghaawoon
verses.translation: Then will they be hurled therein, they and the seducers
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.translit: Wa junoodu Ibleesa ajma'oon
verses.translation: And the hosts of Iblis, together.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.translit: Qaaloo wa hum feehaa yakkhtasimoon
verses.translation: And they will say, when they are quarrelling therein:
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translit: Tallaahi in kunnaa lafee dalaalim mubeen
verses.translation: By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Iz nusawweekum bi Rabbil 'aalameen
verses.translation: When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.translit: Wa maaa adallanaaa illal mujrimoon
verses.translation: It was but the guilty who misled us.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَٰفِعِينَ
verses.translit: Famaa lanaa min shaa fi'een
verses.translation: Now we have no intercessors
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa laa sadeeqin hameem
verses.translation: Nor any loving friend.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةًۭ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Falaw anna lanaa karratan fanakoona minal mu'mineen
verses.translation: Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Inna fee zaalika la Aayatanw wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
verses.translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translit: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
verses.translation: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.translit: Kazzabat qawmu Noohinil Mursaleen
verses.translation: Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah),
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translit: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Noohun alaa tattaqoon
verses.translation: When their brother Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen
verses.translation: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.translit: Fattaqullaaha wa atee'oon
verses.translation: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen
verses.translation: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.translit: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
verses.translation: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
verses.translit: Qaalooo anu'minu laka wattaba 'akal arzaloon
verses.translation: They said: Shall we put faith in thee, when the lowest (of the people) follow thee?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translit: Qaala wa maa 'ilmee bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
verses.translation: He said: And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
verses.translit: In hisaabuhum illaa 'alaa Rabbee law tash'uroon
verses.translation: Lo! their reckoning is my Lord's concern, if ye but knew;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Wa maaa ana bitaaridil mu'mineen
verses.translation: And I am not (here) to repulse believers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.translit: In ana illaa nazeerum mubeen
verses.translation: I am only a plain warner.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
verses.translit: Qaaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa Noohu latakoonanna minal marjoomeen
verses.translation: They said: If thou cease not, O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
verses.translit: Qaala Rabbi inna qawmee kazzaboon
verses.translation: He said: My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Faftab bainee wa bai nahum fat hanw wa najjinee wa mam ma'iya minal mu'mineen
verses.translation: Therefor judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgment, and save me and those believers who are with me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verses.translit: Fa anjainaahu wa mamma'ahoo fil fulkil mashhoon
verses.translation: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
verses.translit: Summa aghraqnaa ba'dul baaqeen
verses.translation: Then afterward We drowned the others.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Inna fee zaalika la Aayaah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
verses.translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translit: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
verses.translation: And lo, thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.translit: Kazzabat 'Aadunil mursaleen
verses.translation: (The tribe of) A'ad denied the messengers (of Allah).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translit: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Hoodun alaa tattaqoon
verses.translation: When their brother Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen
verses.translation: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.translit: Fattaqullaaha wa atee'oon
verses.translation: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Wa maa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen
verses.translation: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةًۭ تَعْبَثُونَ
verses.translit: Atabnoona bikulli ree'in aayatan ta'basoon
verses.translation: Build ye on every high place a monument for vain delight?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
verses.translit: Wa tattakhizoona masaani'a la'allakum takhludoon
verses.translation: And seek ye out strongholds, that haply ye may last for ever?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
verses.translit: Wa izaa batashtum batashtum jabbaareen
verses.translation: And if ye seize by force, seize ye as tyrants?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.translit: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
verses.translation: Rather keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translit: Wattaqul lazeee amad dakum bimaa ta'lamoon
verses.translation: Keep your duty toward Him Who hath aided you with (the good things) that ye know,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَٰمٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
verses.translit: Amaddakum bi an'aa minw wa baneen
verses.translation: Hath aided you with cattle and sons.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَجَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.translit: Wa jannaatinw wa 'uyoon
verses.translation: And gardens and watersprings.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Innee akhaafu 'alaikum 'azaaba Yawmin 'azeem
verses.translation: Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an awful day.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
verses.translit: Qaaloo sawaaa'un 'alainaaa awa 'azta am lam takum minal waa'izeen
verses.translation: They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest or art not of those who preach;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translit: In haazaaa illaa khuluqul awwaleen
verses.translation: This is but a fable of the men of old,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.translit: Wa maa nahnu bimu 'azzabeen
verses.translation: And we shall not be doomed.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Fakazzaboohu fa ahlaknaahum; inna fee zaalika la aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
verses.translation: And they denied him; therefor We destroyed them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translit: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
verses.translation: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.translit: Kazzabat Samoodul mursaleen
verses.translation: (The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translit: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Saalihun alaa tattaqoon
verses.translation: When their brother Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen
verses.translation: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.translit: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
verses.translation: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen
verses.translation: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.translit: Atutrakoona fee maa haahunnaaa aamineen
verses.translation: Will ye be left secure in that which is here before us,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
verses.translit: Fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon
verses.translation: In gardens and watersprings.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَنَخْلٍۢ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa zuroo inw wa nakhlin tal 'uhaa hadeem
verses.translation: And tilled fields and heavy-sheathed palm-trees,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًۭا فَٰرِهِينَ
verses.translit: Wa tanhitoona minal jibaali buyootan faariheen
verses.translation: Though ye hew out dwellings in the mountain, being skilful?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.translit: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
verses.translation: Therefor keep your duty to Allah and obey me,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.translit: Wa laa tutee'ooo amral musrifeen
verses.translation: And obey not the command of the prodigal,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
verses.translit: Allazeena yufsidoona fil ardi wa laa yuslihoon
verses.translation: Who spread corruption in the earth, and reform not.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
verses.translit: Qaalooo innamaa anta minal musahhareen
verses.translation: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.translit: Maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa faati bi Aayatin in kunta minas saadiqeen
verses.translation: Thou art but a mortal like us. So bring some token if thou art of the truthful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌۭ لَّهَا شِرْبٌۭ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
verses.translit: Qaala haazihee naaqatul lahaa shirbunw w alakum shirbu yawmim ma'loom
verses.translation: He said: (Behold) this she-camel. She hath the right to drink (at the well), and ye have the right to drink, (each) on an appointed day.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍۢ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa laa tamassoohaa bisooo'in fa yaakhuzakum 'azaabu Yawmin 'Azeem
verses.translation: And touch her not with ill lest there come on you the retribution of an awful day.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَٰدِمِينَ
verses.translit: Fa'aqaroohaa fa asbahoo naadimeen
verses.translation: But they hamstrung her, and then were penitent.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Fa akhazahumul 'azaab; inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum m'mineen
verses.translation: So the retribution came on them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translit: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
verses.translation: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.translit: kazzabat qawmu Lootinil mursaleen
verses.translation: The folk of Lot denied the messengers (of Allah),
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translit: Iz qaala lahum akhoohum Lootun alaa tattaqoon
verses.translation: When their brother Lot said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Innee lakum rasoolun ameen
verses.translation: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.translit: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
verses.translation: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen
verses.translation: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Ataatoonaz zukraana minal 'aalameen
verses.translation: What! Of all creatures do ye come unto the males,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
verses.translit: Wa tazaroona maa khalaqa lakum Rabbukum min azwaajikum; bal antum qawmun 'aadoon
verses.translation: And leave the wives your Lord created for you? Nay, but ye are froward folk.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
verses.translit: Qaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa Lootu latakoonanna minal mukhrajeen
verses.translation: They said: If thou cease not, O Lot, thou wilt soon be of the outcast.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ إِنِّى لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَالِينَ
verses.translit: Qaala innee li'amalikum minal qaaleen
verses.translation: He said: I am in truth of those who hate your conduct.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: رَبِّ نَجِّنِى وَأَهْلِى مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translit: Rabbi najjjinee wa ahlee mimmmaa ya'maloon
verses.translation: My Lord! Save me and my household from what they do.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.translit: Fanajjainaahu wa ahlahooo ajma'een
verses.translation: So We saved him and his household, every one,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا عَجُوزًۭا فِى ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
verses.translit: Illaa 'ajoozan filghaabireen
verses.translation: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
verses.translit: Summa dammarnal aa khareen
verses.translation: Then afterward We destroyed the others.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًۭا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.translit: Wa amtarnaa 'alaihim mataran fasaaa'a matarul munzareen
verses.translation: And We rained on them a rain. And dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
verses.translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translit: Wa inna Rabbaka la Huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
verses.translation: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.translit: Kazzaba As haabul Aykatil mursaleen
verses.translation: The dwellers in the wood (of Midian) denied the messengers (of Allah),
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translit: Iz qaala lahum Shu'aybun alaa tattaqoon
verses.translation: When Shu'eyb said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Innee lakum Rasoolun ameen
verses.translation: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.translit: Fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
verses.translation: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa Rabbil 'aalameen
verses.translation: And I ask of you no wage for it; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
verses.translit: Awful kaila wa laa takoonoo minal mukhsireen
verses.translation: Give full measure, and be not of those who give less (than the due).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
verses.translit: Wa zinoo bilqistaasil mustaqeem
verses.translation: And weigh with the true balance.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verses.translit: Wa laa tabkhasun naasa ashyaaa 'ahum wa laa ta'saw fil ardi mufsideen
verses.translation: Wrong not mankind in their goods, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translit: Wattaqul lazee khalaqakum waljibillatal awwaleen
verses.translation: And keep your duty unto Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
verses.translit: Qaalooo innamaa anta minal musahhareen
verses.translation: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
verses.translit: Wa maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa wa innazunnuka laminal kaazibeen
verses.translation: Thou art but a mortal like us, and lo! we deem thee of the liars.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
verses.translit: Fa asqit 'alainaa kisafam minas samaaa'i in kunta minas saadiqeen
verses.translation: Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us, if thou art of the truthful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translit: Qaala Rabbeee a'lamu bimaa ta'maloon
verses.translation: He said: My Lord is Best Aware of what ye do.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.translit: Fakazzaboohu fa akhazahum 'azaabu Yawmiz zullah; innahoo kaana 'azaaba Yawmin 'Azeem
verses.translation: But they denied him, so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom. Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Inna fee zaalika la Aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen
verses.translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translit: Wa inna Rabbaka la huwal 'Azeezur Raheem
verses.translation: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Wa innahoo latanzeelu Rabbil 'aalameen
verses.translation: And lo! it is a revelation of the Lord of the Worlds,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
verses.translit: Nazala bihir Roohul Ameen
verses.translation: Which the True Spirit hath brought down
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
verses.translit: 'Alaa qalbika litakoona minal munzireen
verses.translation: Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Bilisaanin 'Arabiyyim mubeen
verses.translation: In plain Arabic speech.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translit: Wa innahoo lafee Zuburil awwaleen
verses.translation: And lo! it is in the Scriptures of the men of old.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.translit: Awalam yakul lahum Aayatan ai ya'lamahoo 'ulamaaa'u Baneee Israaa'eel
verses.translation: Is it not a token for them that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
verses.translit: Wa law nazzalnaahu 'alaa ba'dil a'jameen
verses.translation: And if We had revealed it unto one of any other nation than the Arabs,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Faqara ahoo 'alaihim maa kaanoo bihee mu'mineen
verses.translation: And he had read it unto them, they would not have believed in it.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.translit: Kazaalika salaknaahu fee quloobil mujrimeen
verses.translation: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.translit: Laa yu'minoona bihee hattaa yarawul 'azaabal aleem
verses.translation: They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.translit: Fayaatiyahum baghtatanw wa hum laa yash'uroon
verses.translation: So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
verses.translit: Fa yaqooloo hal nahnu munzaroon
verses.translation: Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.translit: Aafabi 'azaabinaa yasta'jiloon
verses.translation: Would they (now) hasten on Our doom?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
verses.translit: Aara'aita im matta'naahum sineen
verses.translation: Hast thou then seen, if We content them for (long) years,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
verses.translit: Summa jaaa'ahum maa kaanoo yoo'adoon
verses.translation: And then cometh that which they were promised,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
verses.translit: Maaa aghnaaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yumaatoo'oon
verses.translation: (How) that wherewith they were contented naught availeth them?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa maaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa lahaa munziroon
verses.translation: And We destroyed no township but it had its warners
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
verses.translit: Zikraa wa maa kunnaa zaalimeen
verses.translation: For reminder, for We never were oppressors.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
verses.translit: Wa maa tanazzalat bihish Shayaateen
verses.translation: The devils did not bring it down.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
verses.translit: Wa maa yambaghee lahum wa maa yastatee'oon
verses.translation: It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
verses.translit: Innahum 'anis sam'i lama'zooloon
verses.translation: Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.translit: Falaa tad'u ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fatakoona minal mu'azzabeen
verses.translation: Therefor invoke not with Allah another god, lest thou be one of the doomed.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
verses.translit: Wa anzir 'asheeratakal aqrabeen
verses.translation: And warn thy tribe of near kindred,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Wakhfid janaahaka limanit taba 'aka minal mu'mineen
verses.translation: And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translit: Fa in asawka faqul innee bareee'um mimmmaa ta'maloon
verses.translation: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.translit: Wa tawakkal alal 'Azeezir Raheem
verses.translation: And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verses.translit: Allazee yaraaka heena taqoom
verses.translation: Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
verses.translit: Wa taqallubaka fis saajideen
verses.translation: And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.translit: Innahoo Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem
verses.translation: Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
verses.translit: Hal unabbi'ukum 'alaa man tanazzalush Shayaateen
verses.translation: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Tanazzalu 'alaa kulli affaakin aseem
verses.translation: They descend on every sinful, false one.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يُلْقُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَٰذِبُونَ
verses.translit: Yulqoonas sam'a wa aksaruhum aaziboon
verses.translation: They listen eagerly, but most of them are liars.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
verses.translit: Washshu 'araaa'u yattabi 'uhumul ghaawoon
verses.translation: As for poets, the erring follow them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍۢ يَهِيمُونَ
verses.translit: Alam tara annahum fee kulli waadiny yaheemoon
verses.translation: Hast thou not seen how they stray in every valley,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.translit: Wa annahum yaqooloona ma laa yaf'aloon
verses.translation: And how they say that which they do not?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍۢ يَنقَلِبُونَ
verses.translit: Illal lazeena aamanoo w a'amilus saalihaati wa zakarul laaha kaseeranw wantasaroo mim ba'di maa zulimoo; wa saya'lamul lazeena zalamooo aiya munqalbiny yanqaliboon
verses.translation: Save those who believe and do good works, and remember Allah much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. Those who do wrong will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ طسٓ ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translit: Taa-Seeen; tilka Aayaatul Qur-aani wa Kitaabim Mubeen
verses.translation: Ta. Sin. These are revelations of the Qur'an and a Scripture that maketh plain;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هُدًۭى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Hudanw wa bushraa lil mu'mineen
verses.translation: A guidance and good tidings for believers
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
verses.translit: Allazeena yuqeemoonas Salaata wa yu'toonaz Zakaata wa hum bil Aakhirati hum yooqinoon
verses.translation: Who establish worship and pay the poor-due and are sure of the Hereafter.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.translit: Innal lazeena laa yu'mimoona bil Aakhirati zaiyannaa lahum a'maalahum fahum ya'mahoon
verses.translation: Lo! as for those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their works fairseeming unto them so that they are all astray.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ
verses.translit: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena lahum sooo'ul 'azaabi wa hum fil Aakhirati humul akhsaroon
verses.translation: Those are they for whom is the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.translit: Wa innaka latulaqqal Qur-aana mil ladun Hakeemin 'Aleem
verses.translation: Lo! as for thee (Muhammad), thou verily receivest the Qur'an from the presence of One Wise, Aware.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِۦٓ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍۢ قَبَسٍۢ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
verses.translit: Iz qaala Moosaa li ahliheee inneee aanastu naaran saaateekum minhaa bikhabarin aw aateekum bishihaabin qabasil la'allakum tastaloon
verses.translation: (Remember) when Moses said unto his household: Lo! I spy afar off a fire; I will bring you tidings thence, or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِىَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Falammaa jaaa'ahaa noodiya am boorika man finnnnaari wa man hawlahaa wa Subhaanal laahi Rabbil 'aalameen
verses.translation: But when he reached it, he was called, saying: Blessed is Whosoever is in the fire and Whosoever is round about it! And Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.translit: Yaa Moosaaa innahooo Anal laahul 'Azeezul Hakeem
verses.translation: O Moses! Lo! it is I, Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّۭ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًۭا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ إِنِّى لَا يَخَافُ لَدَىَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.translit: Wa alqi 'asaak; falammmaa ra aahaa tahtazzu ka annahaa jaaannunw wallaa mudbiranw wa lam yu'aqqib; yaa Moosaa laa takhaf innee laa yakhaafu ladaiyal mursaloon
verses.translation: And throw down thy staff! But when he saw it writhing as it were a demon, he turned to flee headlong; (but it was said unto him): O Moses! Fear not! the emissaries fear not in My presence,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًۢا بَعْدَ سُوٓءٍۢ فَإِنِّى غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Illaa man zalama summa baddala husnam ba'da sooo'in fa innee Ghafoorur Raheem
verses.translation: Save him who hath done wrong and afterward hath changed evil for good. And lo! I am Forgiving, Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍۢ ۖ فِى تِسْعِ ءَايَٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
verses.translit: Wa adkhil yadaka fee jaibika takhruj baidaaa'a min ghairisooo'in feetis'i Aayaatin ilaa Fir'awna wa qawmih; innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen
verses.translation: And put thy hand into the bosom of thy robe, it will come forth white but unhurt. (This will be one) among nine tokens unto Pharaoh and his people Lo! they were ever evil-living folk.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةًۭ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Falammaa jaaa'at hum Aayaatunaa mubsiratan qaaloo haazaa sihrum mubeen
verses.translation: But when Our tokens came unto them, plain to see, they said: This is mere magic,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَجَحَدُوا۟ بِهَا وَٱسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًۭا وَعُلُوًّۭا ۚ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.translit: Wa jahadoo bihaa wastaiqanat haaa anfusuhum zulmanw-wa 'uluwwaa; fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul mufsideen
verses.translation: And they denied them, though their souls acknowledged them, for spite and arrogance. Then see the nature of the consequence for the wrong-doers!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ عِلْمًۭا ۖ وَقَالَا ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍۢ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Wa laqad aatainaa Daawooda wa sulaimaana 'ilmaa; wa qaalal hamdu lil laahil lazee faddalanaa 'alaa kaseerim min 'ibaadihil mu'mineen
verses.translation: And We verily gave knowledge unto David and Solomon, and they said: Praise be to Allah, Who hath preferred us above many of His believing slaves!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ ۖ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.translit: Wa warisa Sulaimaanu Daawooda wa qaala yaaa aiyuhan naasu 'ullimnaa mantiqat tairi wa ooteenaa min kulli shai'in inna haazaa lahuwal fadlul mubeen
verses.translation: And Solomon was David's heir. And he said: O mankind! Lo! we have been taught the language of birds, and have been given (abundance) of all things. This surely is evident favour.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
verses.translit: Wa hushira Sulaimaana junooduhoo minal jinni wal insi wattairi fahum yooza'oon
verses.translation: And there were gathered together unto Solomon his armies of the jinn and humankind, and of the birds, and they were set in battle order;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌۭ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مَسَٰكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.translit: hattaaa izaaa ataw 'alaa waadin namli qaalat namlatuny yaaa aiyuhan namlud khuloo masaakinakum laa yahtimannakum Sulaimaanu wa junooduhoo wa hum laa yash'uroon
verses.translation: Till, when they reached the Valley of the Ants, an ant exclaimed: O ants! Enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his armies crush you, unperceiving.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًۭا مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًۭا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.translit: Fatabassama daahikam min qawlihaa wa qaala Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'mata kal lateee an'amta 'alaiya wa 'alaa waalidaiya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa adkhilnee birahmatika fee 'ibaadikas saaliheen
verses.translation: And (Solomon) smiled, laughing at her speech, and said: My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and to do good that shall be pleasing unto Thee, and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِىَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْغَآئِبِينَ
verses.translit: Wa tafaqqadat taira faqaala maa liya laaa aral hud hud, am kaana minal ghaaa'ibeen
verses.translation: And he sought among the birds and said: How is it that I see not the hoopoe, or is he among the absent?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَا۟ذْبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّى بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.translit: La-u'azzibanahoo 'azaaban shadeedan aw la azbahannahoo aw layaatiyannee bisultaanim mubeen
verses.translation: I verily will punish him with hard punishment or I verily will slay him, or he verily shall bring me a plain excuse.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍۢ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍۭ بِنَبَإٍۢ يَقِينٍ
verses.translit: Famakasa ghaira ba'eedin faqaala ahattu bimaa lam tuhit bihee wa ji'tuka min Sabaim binaba iny-yaqeen
verses.translation: But he was not long in coming, and he said: I have found out (a thing) that thou apprehendest not, and I come unto thee from Sheba with sure tidings.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةًۭ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Innee wajattum ra atan tamlikuhum wa ootiyat min kulli shai'inw wa lahaa 'arshun 'azeem
verses.translation: Lo! I found a woman ruling over them, and she hath been given (abundance) of all things, and hers is a mighty throne.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.translit: Wajattuhaa wa qawmahaa yasjudoona lishshamsi min doonil laahi wa zaiyana lahumush Shaitaanu a'maalahum fasaddahum 'anis sabeeli fahum laa yahtadoon
verses.translation: I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allah; and Satan maketh their works fairseeming unto them, and debarreth them from the way (of Truth), so that they go not aright;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَّا يَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى يُخْرِجُ ٱلْخَبْءَ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
verses.translit: Allaa yasjudoo lillaahil lazee yukhrijul khab'a fis samaawaati wal ardi wa ya'lamu maa tukhfoona wa maa tu'linoon
verses.translation: So that they worship not Allah, Who bringeth forth the hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knoweth what ye hide and what ye proclaim,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۩
verses.translit: Allaahu laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa Rabbul 'Arshil Azeem
verses.translation: Allah; there is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Tremendous Throne.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
verses.translit: Qaala sananzuru asadaqta am kunta minal kaazibeen
