verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَلَا بِٱلَّذِى بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ مَوْقُوفُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ يَرْجِعُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ٱلْقَوْلَ يَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أَنتُمْ لَكُنَّا مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Wa qaalal lazeena kafaroo lan nu'mina bihaazal Quraani wa laa billazee baina yadayh; wa law taraaa iziz zaalimoona mawqoofoona 'inda Rabbihim yarji'u ba'duhum ilaa ba'dinil qawla yaqoolul lazeenas tud'ifoo lillazeenas takbaroo law laaa antum lakunnaa mu'mineen
verses.translation: And those who disbelieve say: We believe not in this Qur'an nor in that which was before it; but oh, if thou couldst see, when the wrong-doers are brought up before their Lord, how they cast the blame one to another; how those who were despised (in the earth) say unto those who were proud: But for you, we should have been believers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوٓا۟ أَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَٰكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَكُم ۖ بَلْ كُنتُم مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.translit: Qaalal lazeenas takbaroo lillazeenas tud'ifooo anahnu sadadnaakum 'anil hudaa ba'da iz jaaa'akum bal kuntum mujrimeen
verses.translation: Those who were proud say unto those who were despised: Did we drive you away from the guidance after it had come unto you? Nay, but ye were guilty.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ بَلْ مَكْرُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذْ تَأْمُرُونَنَآ أَن نَّكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَنَجْعَلَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادًۭا ۚ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّدَامَةَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلْأَغْلَٰلَ فِىٓ أَعْنَاقِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ هَلْ يُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translit: Wa qaalal lazeenastud'ifoo lillazeenas takbaroo bal makrul laili wannahaari iz taamuroonanaaa an nakfura billaahi wa naj'ala lahooo andaadaa; wa asarrun nadaamata lammaa ra awul 'azaab; wa ja'alnal aghlaala feee a'naaqil lazeena kafaroo; hal yujzawna illaa maa kanoo ya'maloon
verses.translation: Those who were despised say unto those who were proud: Nay but (it was your) scheming night and day, when ye commanded us to disbelieve in Allah and set up rivals unto Him. And they are filled with remorse when they behold the doom; and We place carcans on the necks of those who disbelieved. Are they requited aught save what they used to do?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا فِى قَرْيَةٍۢ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa maaa arsalnaa' fee qaryatim min nazeerin illaa qaala mutrafooaa innaa bimaaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon
verses.translation: And We sent not unto any township a warner, but its pampered ones declared: Lo! we are disbelievers in that wherewith ye have been sent.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أَكْثَرُ أَمْوَٰلًۭا وَأَوْلَٰدًۭا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.translit: Wa qaaloo nahnu aksaru amwaalanw wa awlaadanw wa maa nahnu bimu 'azzabeen
verses.translation: And they say: We are more (than you) in wealth and children. We are not the punished!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translit: Qul inna Rabbee yabsutur rizqa limai yashaaa'u wa yaqdiru wa laakinna aksaran naasi laa ya'lamoon
verses.translation: Say (O Muhammad): Lo! my Lord enlargeth the provision for whom He will and narroweth it (for whom He will). But most of mankind know not.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُكُم بِٱلَّتِى تُقَرِّبُكُمْ عِندَنَا زُلْفَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ جَزَآءُ ٱلضِّعْفِ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْغُرُفَٰتِ ءَامِنُونَ
verses.translit: Wa maaa amwaalukum wa laaa awlaadukum billatee tuqarribukum 'indanaa zulfaaa illaa man aamana wa 'amila saalihan fa ulaaa'ika lahum jazaaa'ud di'fi bimaa 'amiloo wa hum fil ghurufaati aaminoon
verses.translation: And it is not your wealth nor your children that will bring you near unto Us, but he who believeth and doeth good (he draweth near). As for such, theirs will be twofold reward for what they did and they will dwell secure in lofty halls.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَسْعَوْنَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ
verses.translit: Wallazeena yas'awna feee Aayaatinaa mu'aajizeena ulaaa'ika fil'azaabi muhdaroon
verses.translation: And as for those who strive against Our revelations, challenging, they will be brought to the doom.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥ ۚ وَمَآ أَنفَقْتُم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ فَهُوَ يُخْلِفُهُۥ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
verses.translit: Qul inna Rabbee yabsutur rizqa limai yashaaa'u min 'ibaadihee wa yaqdiru lah; wa maaa anfaqtum min shai'in fahuwa yukhlifuhoo wa Huwa khairur raaziqeen
verses.translation: Say: Lo! my Lord enlargeth the provision for whom He will of His bondmen, and narroweth (it) for him. And whatsoever ye spend (for good) He replaceth it. And He is the Best of Providers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ أَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِيَّاكُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
verses.translit: Wa yawma yahshuruhum jamee'an summa yaqoolu lilmalaaa'ikati a-haaa'ulaaa'i iyyaakum kaanoo ya'budoon
verses.translation: And on the day when He will gather them all together, He will say unto the angels: Did these worship you?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَكَ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا مِن دُونِهِم ۖ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ ٱلْجِنَّ ۖ أَكْثَرُهُم بِهِم مُّؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translit: Qaaloo Subhaanaka Anta waliyyunaa min doonihim bal kaanoo ya'budoonal jinna aksaruhum bihim mu'minoon
verses.translation: They will say: Be Thou Glorified. Thou (alone) art our Guardian, not them! Nay, but they worshipped the jinn; most of them were believers in them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يَمْلِكُ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍۢ نَّفْعًۭا وَلَا ضَرًّۭا وَنَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translit: Fal Yawma laa yamliku ba'dukum liba'din naf'anw wa laa darraa; wa naqoolu lilzeena zalamoo zooqoo 'azaaban Naaril latee kuntum bihaa tukazziboon
verses.translation: That day ye will possess no use nor hurt one for another. And We shall say unto those who did wrong: Taste the doom of the Fire which ye used to deny.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالُوا۟ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۭ يُرِيدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُكُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌۭ مُّفْتَرًۭى ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa izaa tutlaa 'alaihim Aayaatunaa baiyinaatin qaaloo maa haazaa illaa rajuluny yureedu ai-yasuddakum 'ammaa kaana ya'budu aabaaa'ukum wa qaaloo maa haazaaa illaaa ifkum muftaraa; wa qaalal lazeena kafaroo lilhaqqi lammaa jaaa'ahum in haazaaa illaa sihrum mubeen
verses.translation: And if Our revelations are recited unto them in plain terms, they say: This is naught else than a man who would turn you away from what your fathers used to worship; and they say: This is naught else than an invented lie. Those who disbelieve say of the truth when it reacheth them: This is naught else than mere magic.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّن كُتُبٍۢ يَدْرُسُونَهَا ۖ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ قَبْلَكَ مِن نَّذِيرٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa maaa aatainaahum min Kutubiny yadrusoonahaa wa maaa arsalnaaa ilaihim qablaka min nazeer
verses.translation: And We have given them no scriptures which they study, nor sent We unto them, before thee, any warner.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَكَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَمَا بَلَغُوا۟ مِعْشَارَ مَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ رُسُلِى ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.translit: Wa kazzabal lazeena min qablihim wa maa balaghoo mi'shaara maaa aatainaahum fakazzaboo Rusulee; fakaifa kaana nakeer
verses.translation: Those before them denied, and these have not attained a tithe of that which We bestowed on them (of old); yet they denied My messengers. How intense then was My abhorrence (of them)!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَعِظُكُم بِوَٰحِدَةٍ ۖ أَن تَقُومُوا۟ لِلَّهِ مَثْنَىٰ وَفُرَٰدَىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ ۚ مَا بِصَاحِبِكُم مِّن جِنَّةٍ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ لَّكُم بَيْنَ يَدَىْ عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ
verses.translit: Qul innamaaa a'izukum biwaahidatin an taqoomoo lillaahi masnaa wa furaadaa summa tatafakkaroo; maa bisaahibikum min jinnah; in huwa illaa nazeerul lakum baina yadai 'azaabin shadeed
verses.translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I exhort you unto one thing only: that ye awake, for Allah's sake, by twos and singly, and then reflect: There is no madness in your comrade. He is naught else than a warner unto you in face of a terrific doom.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ مَا سَأَلْتُكُم مِّنْ أَجْرٍۢ فَهُوَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌۭ
verses.translit: Qul maa sa-altukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum in ajriya illaa 'alal laahi wa Huwa 'alaa kullin shai-in Shaheed
verses.translation: Say: Whatever reward I might have asked of you is yours. My reward is the affair of Allah only. He is Witness over all things.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ إِنَّ رَبِّى يَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَّٰمُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ
verses.translit: Qul inna Rabbee yaqzifu bilhaqq 'Allaamul Ghuyoob
verses.translation: Say: Lo! my Lord hurleth the truth. (He is) the Knower of Things Hidden.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَمَا يُبْدِئُ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ
verses.translit: Qul jaaa'al haqqu wa maa yubdi'ul baatilu wa maa yu'eed
verses.translation: Say: The Truth hath come, and falsehood showeth not its face and will not return.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ إِن ضَلَلْتُ فَإِنَّمَآ أَضِلُّ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِى ۖ وَإِنِ ٱهْتَدَيْتُ فَبِمَا يُوحِىٓ إِلَىَّ رَبِّىٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ سَمِيعٌۭ قَرِيبٌۭ
verses.translit: Qul in dalaltu fainnamaaa adillu 'alaa nafsee wa inih-tadaitu fabimaa yoohee ilaiya Rabbee; innahoo Samee'un Qareeb
verses.translation: Say: If I err, I err only to my own loss, and if I am rightly guided it is because of that which my Lord hath revealed unto me. Lo! He is Hearer, Nigh.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذْ فَزِعُوا۟ فَلَا فَوْتَ وَأُخِذُوا۟ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa law taraaa iz fazi'oo falaa fawta wa ukhizoo mim makaanin qareeb
verses.translation: Couldst thou but see when they are terrified with no escape, and are seized from near at hand,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa qaloo aamannaa bihee wa annaa lahumut tanaawushu mim makaanim ba'eed
verses.translation: And say: We (now) believe therein. But how can they reach (faith) from afar off,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَيَقْذِفُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa qad kafaroo bihee min qablu wa yaqzifoona bilghaibi mim makaanim ba'eed
verses.translation: When they disbelieved in it of yore. They aim at the unseen from afar off.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَحِيلَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ مَا يَشْتَهُونَ كَمَا فُعِلَ بِأَشْيَاعِهِم مِّن قَبْلُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ فِى شَكٍّۢ مُّرِيبٍۭ
verses.translit: Wa heela bainahum wa baina maa yashtahoona kamaa fu'ila bi-ashyaa'ihim min qabl; innahum kaanoo fee shakkim mureeb
verses.translation: And a gulf is set between them and that which they desire, as was done for people of their kind of old. Lo! they were in hopeless doubt.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُو۟لِىٓ أَجْنِحَةٍۢ مَّثْنَىٰ وَثُلَٰثَ وَرُبَٰعَ ۚ يَزِيدُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
verses.translit: Alhamdu lillaahi faatiris samaawaati wal ardi jaa'ilil malaaa'ikati rusulan uleee ajnihatim masnaa wa sulaasa wa rubaa'; yazeedu fil khalqi maa yashaaa'; innal laaha 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeer
verses.translation: Praise be to Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, Who appointeth the angels messengers having wings two, three and four. He multiplieth in creation what He will. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَّا يَفْتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍۢ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.translit: Maa yaftahil laahu linnaaasi mir rahmatin falaa mumsika lahaa wa maa yumsik falaa mursila lahoo mimb'dih; wa Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem
verses.translation: That which Allah openeth unto mankind of mercy none can withhold it; and that which He withholdeth none can release thereafter. He is the Mighty, the Wise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ هَلْ مِنْ خَٰلِقٍ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
verses.translit: Yaaa ayyuhan naasuzkuroo ni'matal laahi 'alaikum; hal min khaaliqin ghairul laahi yarzuqukum minas samaaa'i wal ard; laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa fa annaa tu'fakoon
verses.translation: O mankind! Remember Allah's grace toward you! Is there any creator other than Allah who provideth for you from the sky and the earth? There is no Allah save Him. Whither then are ye turned?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كُذِّبَتْ رُسُلٌۭ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verses.translit: Wa iny yukazzibooka faqad kuzzibat Rusulum min qablik; wa ilal laahi turja'ul umoor
verses.translation: And if they deny thee, (O Muhammad), messengers (of Allah) were denied before thee. Unto Allah all things are brought back.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ
verses.translit: Yaaa ayyuhan naasu inna wa'dal laahi haqqun falaa taghurrannakumul hayaatud dunyaa; wa laa yaghurran nakum billaahil gharoor
verses.translation: O mankind! Lo! the promise of Allah is true. So let not the life of the world beguile you, and let not the (avowed) beguiler beguile you with regard to Allah.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ فَٱتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا ۚ إِنَّمَا يَدْعُوا۟ حِزْبَهُۥ لِيَكُونُوا۟ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.translit: Innash shaitaana lakum 'aduwwun fattakhizoohu 'aduwwaa; innamaa yad'oo hizbahoo liyakoonoo min ashaabis sa'eer
verses.translation: Lo! the devil is an enemy for you, so treat him as an enemy. He only summoneth his faction to be owners of the flaming Fire.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌ
verses.translit: Allazeena kafaroo lahum 'azaabun shadeed; wallazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum maghfiratunw wa ajrun kabeer
verses.translation: Those who disbelieve, theirs will be an awful doom; and those who believe and do good works, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ فَرَءَاهُ حَسَنًۭا ۖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَٰتٍ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ
verses.translit: Afaman zuyyina lahoo sooo'u 'amalihee fara aahu hasanaa; fa innal laaha yudillu mai yashaaa'u wa yahdee mai yahaaa'u falaa tazhab nafsuka 'alaihim hasaraat; innal laaha 'aleemun bimaa yasna'oon
verses.translation: Is he, the evil of whose deeds is made fairseeming unto him so that he deemeth it good, (other than Satan's dupe)? Allah verily sendeth whom He will astray, and guideth whom He will; so let not thy soul expire in sighings for them. Lo! Allah is Aware of what they do!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًۭا فَسُقْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍۢ مَّيِّتٍۢ فَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلنُّشُورُ
verses.translit: Wallaahul lazeee arsalar riyaaha fatuseeru shaaban fasuqnaahu ilaa baladim maiyitin fa ahyaynaa bihil arda ba'da mawtihaa; kazaalikan nushoor
verses.translation: And Allah it is Who sendeth the winds and they raise a cloud; then We lead it unto a dead land and revive therewith the earth after its death. Such is the Resurrection.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ ٱلْكَلِمُ ٱلطَّيِّبُ وَٱلْعَمَلُ ٱلصَّٰلِحُ يَرْفَعُهُۥ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۖ وَمَكْرُ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ
verses.translit: Man kaana yureedul 'izzata falillaahil 'izzatu jamee'aa; ilaihi yas'adul kalimut taiyibu wal'amalus saalihu yarfa'uh; wallazeena yamkuroonas sayyiaati lahum 'azaabun shadeed; wa makru ulaaa'ika huwa yaboor
verses.translation: Whoso desireth power (should know that) all power belongeth to Allah. Unto Him good words ascend, and the pious deed doth He exalt; but those who plot iniquities, theirs will be an awful doom; and the plotting of such (folk) will come to naught.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ۚ وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٍۢ وَلَا يُنقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِۦٓ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ
verses.translit: Wallaahu khalaqakum min turaabin summa min nutfatin summa ja'alakum azwaajaa; wa maa tahmilu min unsaa wa laa tada'u illaa bi'ilmih; wa maa yu'ammaru mim mu'ammarinw wa laa yunqasu min 'umuriheee illaa fee kitaab; inna zaalika 'alal laahi yaseer
verses.translation: Allah created you from dust, then from a little fluid, then He made you pairs (the male and female). No female beareth or bringeth forth save with His knowledge. And no-one groweth old who groweth old, nor is aught lessened of his life, but it is recorded in a Book, Lo! that is easy for Allah.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْبَحْرَانِ هَٰذَا عَذْبٌۭ فُرَاتٌۭ سَآئِغٌۭ شَرَابُهُۥ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌۭ ۖ وَمِن كُلٍّۢ تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْمًۭا طَرِيًّۭا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةًۭ تَلْبَسُونَهَا ۖ وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ فِيهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa maa yastawil bahraani haaza 'azbun furaatun saaa'ighun sharaabuhoo wa haazaa milhun ujaaj; wa min kullin taakuloona lahman tariyyanw wa tastakhrijoona hilyatan talbasoonahaa wa taral fulka feehi mawaakhira litabtaghoo min fadlihee wa la'allakm tashkuroon
verses.translation: And the two seas are not alike: this, fresh, sweet, good to drink, this (other) bitter, salt. And from them both ye eat fresh meat and derive the ornament that ye wear. And thou seest the ship cleaving them with its prow that ye may seek of His bounty, and that haply ye may give thanks.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِن قِطْمِيرٍ
verses.translit: Yoolijul laila fin nahaari wa yoolijun nahaara fil laili wa sakhkharash shamsa wal qamara kulluny yajree li ajalim musammaa; zaalikumul lahuu Rabbukum lahul mulk; wallazeena tad'oona min doonihee maa yamlikoona min qitmeer
verses.translation: He maketh the night to pass into the day and He maketh the day to pass into the night. He hath subdued the sun and moon to service. Each runneth unto an appointed term. Such is Allah, your Lord; His is the Sovereignty; and those unto whom ye pray instead of Him own not so much as the white spot on a date-stone.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِن تَدْعُوهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوا۟ دُعَآءَكُمْ وَلَوْ سَمِعُوا۟ مَا ٱسْتَجَابُوا۟ لَكُمْ ۖ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍۢ
verses.translit: in tad'oohum laa yasma'oo du'aaa'akum wa law sami'oo mas tajaaboo lakum; wa Yawmal Qiyaamati Yakfuroona bishirkikum; wa laa yunabbi'uka mislu khabeer
verses.translation: If ye pray unto them they hear not your prayer, and if they heard they could not grant it you. On the Day of Resurrection they will disown association with you. None can inform you like Him Who is Aware.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
verses.translit: Yaaa ayyunhan naasu antumul fuqaraaa'u ilallaahi wallaahu Huwal Ghaniyyul Hameed
verses.translation: O mankind! Ye are the poor in your relation to Allah. And Allah! He is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ
verses.translit: Iny yashaa yuzhibkum wa yaati bikhalqin jadeed
verses.translation: If He will, He can be rid of you and bring (instead of you) some new creation.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa maa zaalika 'alal laahi bi'azeez
verses.translation: That is not a hard thing for Allah.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَإِن تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَىٰ حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌۭ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰٓ ۗ إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۚ وَمَن تَزَكَّىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّىٰ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.translit: Wa laa taziru waaziratun wizra ukhraa; wa in tad'u musqalatun ilaa himlihaa laa yuhmal minhu shai'unw wa law kaana zaa qurbaa; innamaa tunzirul lazeena yakhshawna Rabbahum bilghaibi wa aqaamus Sallah; wa man tazakkaa fa innamaa yatazakkaa linafsih; wa ilal laahil maseer
verses.translation: And no burdened soul can bear another's burden, and if one heavy laden crieth for (help with) his load, naught of it will be lifted even though he (unto whom he crieth) be of kin. Thou warnest only those who fear their Lord in secret, and have established worship. He who groweth (in goodness), groweth only for himself, (he cannot by his merit redeem others). Unto Allah is the journeying.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ
verses.translit: Wa maa tastawil a'maa wal baseer
verses.translation: The blind man is not equal with the seer;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَا ٱلظُّلُمَٰتُ وَلَا ٱلنُّورُ
verses.translit: Wa laz zulumaatu wa lannoon
verses.translation: Nor is darkness (tantamount to) light;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَا ٱلظِّلُّ وَلَا ٱلْحَرُورُ
verses.translit: Wa laz zillu wa lal haroor
verses.translation: Nor is the shadow equal with the sun's full heat;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَحْيَآءُ وَلَا ٱلْأَمْوَٰتُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُسْمِعٍۢ مَّن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
verses.translit: Wa maa yastawil ahyaaa'u wa lal amwaat; innal laaha yusmi'u mai yashaaa'u wa maaa anta bimusi'im man fil quboor
verses.translation: Nor are the living equal with the dead. Lo! Allah maketh whom He will to hear. Thou canst not reach those who are in the graves.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنْ أَنتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ
verses.translit: In anta illaa nazeer
verses.translation: Thou art but a warner.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ بَشِيرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا ۚ وَإِن مِّنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌۭ
verses.translit: Innaa arsalnaak bil haqqi basheeranw wa nazeeraa; wa im min ummatin illaa khalaa feehaa nazeer
verses.translation: Lo! We have sent thee with the Truth, a bearer of glad tidings and a warner; and there is not a nation but a warner hath passed among them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَبِٱلزُّبُرِ وَبِٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُنِيرِ
verses.translit: Wa inyukazzibooka faqad kazzabal lazeena min qablihim jaaa'at hum Rusuluhum bilbaiyinaati wa biz Zuburi wa bil Kitaabil Muneer
verses.translation: And if they deny thee, those before them also denied. Their messengers came unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), and with the Psalms and the Scripture giving light.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.translit: Summa akhaztul lazeena kafaroo fakaifa kaana nakeer
verses.translation: Then seized I those who disbelieved, and how intense was My abhorrence!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦ ثَمَرَٰتٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهَا ۚ وَمِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌۢ بِيضٌۭ وَحُمْرٌۭ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌۭ
verses.translit: Alam tara annal laaha anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa akhrajnaa bihee samaraatim mukhtalifan alwaanuhaa; wa minal jibaali judadum beedunw wa humrum mukhtalifun alwaanuhaa wa gharaabeebu sood
verses.translation: Hast thou not seen that Allah causeth water to fall from the sky, and We produce therewith fruit of divers hues; and among the hills are streaks white and red, of divers hues, and (others) raven-black;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَٱلدَّوَآبِّ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ كَذَٰلِكَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْعُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ
verses.translit: Wa minan naasi wadda waaabbi wal an'aami mukhtalifun alwaanuhoo kazalik; innamaa yakhshal laaha min 'ibaadihil 'ulamaaa'; innal laaha 'Azeezun Ghafoor
verses.translation: And of men and beasts and cattle, in like manner, divers hues? The erudite among His bondmen fear Allah alone. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Forgiving.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَٰبَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ سِرًّۭا وَعَلَانِيَةًۭ يَرْجُونَ تِجَٰرَةًۭ لَّن تَبُورَ
verses.translit: Innal lazeena yatloona Kitabbal laahi wa aqaamus Salaata wa anfaqoo mimmaa razaqnaahum sirranw wa 'alaa niyatany yarjoona tijaaratal lan taboor
verses.translation: Lo! those who read the Scripture of Allah, and establish worship, and spend of that which We have bestowed on them secretly and openly, they look forward to imperishable gain,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ غَفُورٌۭ شَكُورٌۭ
verses.translit: Liyuwaffiyahum ujoorahum wa yazeedahum min fadlih; innahoo Ghafoorun Shakoor
verses.translation: That He will pay them their wages and increase them of His grace. Lo! He is Forgiving, Responsive.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ لَخَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ
verses.translit: Wallaeee awhainaaa ilaika minal Kitaabi huwal haqqu musaddiqal limaa baina yadayh; innal laaha bi'ibaadihee la khabeerum Baseer
verses.translation: As for that which We inspire in thee of the Scripture, it is the Truth confirming that which was (revealed) before it. Lo! Allah is indeed Observer, Seer of His slaves.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۖ فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ وَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌۭ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌۢ بِٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.translit: Summa awrasnal Kitaaballazeenas tafainaa min 'ibaadinaa faminhum zaalimul linafsihee wa minhum muqtasid, wa minhum saabiqum bilkhairaati bi iznil laah; zaalika huwal fadlul kabeer
verses.translation: Then We gave the Scripture as inheritance unto those whom We elected of Our bondmen. But of them are some who wrong themselves and of them are some who are lukewarm, and of them are some who outstrip (others) through good deeds, by Allah's leave. That is the great favour!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍۢ وَلُؤْلُؤًۭا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌۭ
verses.translit: jannaatu 'adniny yad khuloonahaa yuhallawna feeha min asaawira min zahabinw wa lu'lu'anw wa libaa suhum feehaa hareer
verses.translation: Gardens of Eden! They enter them wearing armlets of gold and pearl and their raiment therein is silk.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا ٱلْحَزَنَ ۖ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌۭ شَكُورٌ
verses.translit: Wa qaalul hamdu lillaahil lazeee azhaba 'annal hazan; inna Rabbanaa la Ghafoorun Shakoor
verses.translation: And they say: Praise be to Allah Who hath put grief away from us. Lo! Our Lord is Forgiving, Bountiful,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ ٱلْمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌۭ
verses.translit: Allazeee ahallanaa daaral muqaamati min fadlihee laa yamassunaa feehaa nasabunw wa laa yamassunaa feehaa lughoob
verses.translation: Who, of His grace, hath installed us in the mansion of eternity, where toil toucheth us not nor can weariness affect us.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا۟ وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُم مِّنْ عَذَابِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى كُلَّ كَفُورٍۢ
verses.translit: Wallazeena kafaroo lahum naaru Jahannama laa yuqdaa 'alaihim fa yamootoo wa laa yukhaffafu 'anhum min 'azaabihaa; kazaalika najzee kulla kafoor
verses.translation: But as for those who disbelieve, for them is fire of hell; it taketh not complete effect upon them so that they can die, nor is its torment lightened for them. Thus We punish every ingrate.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ ۚ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَآءَكُمُ ٱلنَّذِيرُ ۖ فَذُوقُوا۟ فَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
verses.translit: Wa hum yastarikhoona feehaa Rabbanaa akhrijnaa na'mal saalihan ghairal lazee kunnaa na'mal; awa lamnu 'ammirkum maa yatazak karu feehi man tazakkara wa jaaa'akumun nazeeru fazooqoo famaa lizzaalimeena min naseer
verses.translation: And they cry for help there, (saying): Our Lord! Release us; we will do right, not (the wrong) that we used to do. Did not We grant you a life long enough for him who reflected to reflect therein? And the warner came unto you. Now taste (the flavour of your deeds), for evil-doers have no helper.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَٰلِمُ غَيْبِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.translit: Innal laaha 'aalimu ghaibis samaawaati wal ard; innahoo 'aleemum bizaatis sudoor
verses.translation: Lo! Allah is the Knower of the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. Lo! He is Aware of the secret of (men's) breasts.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَٰٓئِفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًۭا ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verses.translit: Huwal lazee ja'alakum khalaaa'ifa fil ard; faman kafara fa'alaihi kufruhoo; wa laa yazeedul kaafireena kufruhum 'inda Rabbihim illaa maqtanw wa la yazeedul kaafireena kufruhum illaa khasaaraa
verses.translation: He it is Who hath made you regents in the earth; so he who disbelieveth, his disbelief be on his own head. Their disbelief increaseth for the disbelievers, in their Lord's sight, naught save abhorrence. Their disbelief increaseth for the disbelievers naught save loss.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ شُرَكَآءَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌۭ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ كِتَٰبًۭا فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَتٍۢ مِّنْهُ ۚ بَلْ إِن يَعِدُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا
verses.translit: Qul ara'aytum shurakaaa'a kumul lazeena tad'oona min doonil laah; aroonee maazaa khalaqoo minal ardi am lahum shirkun fis samaawaati am aatainaahum Kitaaban fahum 'alaa baiyinatim minh; bal iny ya'iiduz zaalimoona ba 'duhum ba'dan illaa ghurooraa
verses.translation: Say: Have ye seen your partner-gods to whom ye pray beside Allah? Show me what they created of the earth! Or have they any portion in the heavens? Or have We given them a scripture so they act on clear proof therefrom? Nay, the evil-doers promise one another only to deceive.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ أَن تَزُولَا ۚ وَلَئِن زَالَتَآ إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًۭا
verses.translit: Innal laaha yumsikus samaawaati wal arda an tazoolaaa; wa la'in zaalataaa in amsa kahumaa min ahadim mim ba'dih; innahoo kaana Haleeman Ghafooraa
verses.translation: Lo! Allah graspeth the heavens and the earth that they deviate not, and if they were to deviate there is not one that could grasp them after Him. Lo! He is ever Clement, Forgiving.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ لَئِن جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْ إِحْدَى ٱلْأُمَمِ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مَّا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا
verses.translit: Wa aqsamoo billaahi jahda aymaanihim la'in jaaa'ahum nazeerul layakoonunna ahdaa min ihdal umami falam maa jaaa'ahum nazeerum maa zaadahum illaa nufooraa
verses.translation: And they swore by Allah, their most binding oath, that if a warner came unto them they would be more tractable than any of the nations; yet, when a warner came unto them it aroused in them naught save repugnance,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ ٱلسَّيِّئِ ۚ وَلَا يَحِيقُ ٱلْمَكْرُ ٱلسَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِۦ ۚ فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًۭا ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا
verses.translit: Istakbaaran fil ardi wa makras sayyi'; wa laa yaheequl makrus sayyi'u illaa bi ahlih; fahal yanzuroona illaa sunnatal awwaleen; falan tajida lisunnatil laahi tabdeelanw wa lan tajida lisunnatil laahi tahweela
verses.translation: (Shown in their) behaving arrogantly in the land and plotting evil; and the evil plot encloseth but the men who make it. Then, can they expect aught save the treatment of the folk of old? Thou wilt not find for Allah's way of treatment any substitute, nor wilt thou find for Allah's way of treatment aught of power to change.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُۥ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمًۭا قَدِيرًۭا
verses.translit: Awalam yaseeroo fil ardi fa yanzuroo kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul lazeena min qblihim wa kaanoo ashadda minhum quwwah; wa maa kaanal laahu liyu'jizahoo min shai'in fis samaawaati wa laa fil ard; innahoo kaana 'Aleeman Qadeeraa
verses.translation: Have they not travelled in the land and seen the nature of the consequence for those who were before them, and they were mightier than these in power? Allah is not such that aught in the heavens or in the earth escapeth Him. Lo! He is the Wise, the Mighty.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ بَصِيرًۢا
verses.translit: Wa law yu'aakhizul laahun naasa bima kasaboo maa taraka 'alaa zahrihaa min daaabbatinw wa laakiny yu'akhkhiruhum ilaaa ajalim musamman fa izaa jaaa'a ajaluhum fa innal laaha kaana bi'ibaadihee Baseeraa
verses.translation: If Allah took mankind to task by that which they deserve, He would not leave a living creature on the surface of the earth; but He reprieveth them unto an appointed term, and when their term cometh - then verily (they will know that) Allah is ever Seer of His slaves.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يسٓ
verses.translit: Yaa-Seeen
verses.translation: Ya Sin.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.translit: Wal-Qur-aanil-Hakeem
verses.translation: By the wise Qur'an,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.translit: Innaka laminal mursaleen
verses.translation: Lo! thou art of those sent
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: 'Alaa Siraatim Mustaqeem
verses.translation: On a straight path,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verses.translit: Tanzeelal 'Azeezir Raheem
verses.translation: A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
verses.translit: Litunzira qawmam maaa unzira aabaaa'uhum fahum ghaafiloon
verses.translation: That thou mayst warn a folk whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translit: Laqad haqqal qawlu 'alaaa aksarihim fahum laa yu'minoon
verses.translation: Already hath the judgment, (for their infidelity) proved true of most of them, for they believe not.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَٰلًۭا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
verses.translit: Innaa ja'alnaa feee a'naaqihim aghlaalan fahiya ilal azqaani fahum muqmahoon
verses.translation: Lo! We have put on their necks carcans reaching unto the chins, so that they are made stiff-necked.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّۭا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّۭا فَأَغْشَيْنَٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa ja'alnaa mim baini aydeehim saddanw-wa min khalfihim saddan fa aghshai naahum fahum laa yubsiroon
verses.translation: And We have set a bar before them and a bar behind them, and (thus) have covered them so that they see not.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translit: Wa sawaaa'un 'alaihim 'a-anzartahum am lam tunzirhum laa yu'minoon
verses.translation: Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not, it is alike for them, for they believe not.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍۢ وَأَجْرٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
verses.translit: Innamaa tunziru manit taba 'az-Zikra wa khashiyar Rahmaana bilghaib, fabashshirhu bimaghfiratinw-wa ajrin kareem
verses.translation: Thou warnest only him who followeth the Reminder and feareth the Beneficent in secret. To him bear tidings of forgiveness and a rich reward.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Innaa Nahnu nuhyil mawtaa wa naktubu maa qaddamoo wa aasaarahum; wa kulla shai'in ahsainaahu feee Imaamim Mubeen
verses.translation: Lo! We it is Who bring the dead to life. We record that which they send before (them, and their footprints. And all things We have kept in a clear Register.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.translit: Wadrib lahum masalan Ashaabal Qaryatih; iz jaaa'ahal mursaloon
verses.translation: Coin for them a similitude: The people of the city when those sent (from Allah) came unto them;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verses.translit: Iz arsalnaaa ilaihimusnaini fakazzaboohumaa fa'azzaznaa bisaalisin faqaalooo innaaa ilaikum mursaloon
verses.translation: When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
verses.translit: Qaaloo maaa antum illaa basharum mislunaa wa maaa anzalar Rahmaanu min shai'in in antum illaa takziboon
verses.translation: They said: Ye are but mortals like unto us. The Beneficent hath naught revealed. Ye do but lie!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.translit: Qaaloo Rabbunaa ya'lamu innaaa ilaikum lamursaloon
verses.translation: They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.translit: Wa maa 'alainaaa illal balaaghul mubeen
verses.translation: And our duty is but plain conveyance (of the message).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Qaaloo innaa tataiyarnaa bikum la'il-lam tantahoo lanar jumannakum wa la-yamassan nakum minnaa 'azaabun aleem
verses.translation: (The people of the city) said: We augur ill of you. If ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and grievous torture will befall you at our hands.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّسْرِفُونَ
verses.translit: Qaaloo taaa'irukum ma'akum; a'in zukkirtum; bal antum qawmum musrifoon
verses.translation: They said: Your evil augury be with you! Is it because ye are reminded (of the truth)? Nay, but ye are froward folk!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌۭ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.translit: Wa jaaa'a min aqsal madeenati rajuluny yas'aa qaala yaa qawmit tabi'ul mursaleen
verses.translation: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًۭا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
verses.translit: Ittabi'oo mal-laa yas'alukum ajranw-wa hum muhtadoon
verses.translation: Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.translit: Wa maa liya laaa a'budul lazee fataranee wa ilaihi turja'oon
verses.translation: For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ بِضُرٍّۢ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
verses.translit: 'A-attakhizu min dooniheee aalihatan iny-yuridnir Rahmaanu bidurril-laa tughni 'annee shafaa 'atuhum shai 'anw-wa laa yunqizoon
verses.translation: Shall I take (other) gods in place of Him when, if the Beneficent should wish me any harm, their intercession will avail me naught, nor can they save?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنِّىٓ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translit: Inneee izal-lafee dalaa-lim-mubeen
verses.translation: Then truly I should be in error manifest.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
verses.translit: Inneee aamantu bi Rabbikum fasma'oon
verses.translation: Lo! I have believed in your Lord, so hear me!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translit: Qeelad khulil Jannnah; qaala yaa laita qawmee ya'lamoon
verses.translation: It was said (unto him): Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.translit: Bimaa ghafara lee Rabbee wa ja'alanee minal mukrameen
verses.translation: With what (munificence) my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
verses.translit: Wa maaa anzalnaa 'alaa qawmihee mim ba'dihee min jundim minas-samaaa'i wa maa kunnaa munzileen
verses.translation: We sent not down against his people after him a host from heaven, nor do We ever send.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ خَٰمِدُونَ
verses.translit: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum khaamidoon
verses.translation: It was but one Shout, and lo! they were extinct.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.translit: Yaa hasratan 'alal 'ibaad; maa yaateehim mir Rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi 'oon
verses.translation: Ah, the anguish for the bondmen! Never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.translit: Alam yaraw kam ahlak naa qablahum minal qurooni annahum ilaihim laa yarji'oon
verses.translation: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, which indeed returned not unto them;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِن كُلٌّۭ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa in kullul lammaa jamee'ul-ladainaa muhdaroon
verses.translation: But all, without exception, will be brought before Us.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّۭا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
verses.translit: Wa Aayatul lahumul ardul maitatu ahyainaahaa wa akhrajnaa minhaa habban faminhu yaakuloon
verses.translation: A token unto them is the dead earth. We revive it, and We bring forth from it grain so that they eat thereof;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
verses.translit: Wa ja'alnaa feehaa jannaatim min nakheelinw wa a'naabinw wa fajjarnaa feeha minal 'uyoon
verses.translation: And We have placed therein gardens of the date-palm and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.translit: Liyaakuloo min samarihee wa maa 'amilat-hu aideehim; afalaa yashkuroon
verses.translation: That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translit: Subhaanal lazee khalaqal azwaaja kullahaa mimmaa tumbitul ardu wa min anfusihim wa mimmaa laa ya'lamoon
verses.translation: Glory be to Him Who created all the sexual pairs, of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
verses.translit: Wa Aayatul lahumul lailu naslakhu minhun nahaara fa-izaa hum muzlimoon
verses.translation: A token unto them is night. We strip it of the day, and lo! they are in darkness.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
verses.translit: Wash-shamsu tajree limustaqarril lahaa; zaalika taqdeerul 'Azeezil Aleem
verses.translation: And the sun runneth on unto a resting-place for him. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
verses.translit: Walqamara qaddarnaahu manaazila hattaa 'aada kal'ur joonil qadeem
verses.translation: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ
verses.translit: Lash shamsu yambaghee lahaaa an tudrikal qamara wa lal lailu saabiqun nahaar; wa kullun fee falaki yasbahoon
verses.translation: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verses.translit: Wa Aayatul lahum annaa hamalnaa zurriyatahum fil fulkil mashhoon
verses.translation: And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
verses.translit: Wa khalaqnaa lahum mim-mislihee maa yarkaboon
verses.translation: And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
verses.translit: Wa in nashaa nughriqhum falaa sareekha lahum wa laa hum yunqazoon
verses.translation: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Illaa rahmatam minnaa wa mataa'an ilaa heen
verses.translation: Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.translit: Wa izaa qeela lahumuttaqoo maa baina aideekum wa maa khalfakum la'allakum turhamoon
verses.translation: When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.translit: Wa maa taateehim min aayatim min ayataati Rabbihim illaa kaanoo 'anhaa mu'rideen
verses.translation: Never came a token of the tokens of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa izaa qeela lahum anfiqoo mimmaa razaqakumul laahu qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo anut'imu mal-law yashaaa'ul laahu at'amahooo in antum illaa fee dalaalim mubeen
verses.translation: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.translit: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
verses.translation: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
verses.translit: Maa yanzuroona illaa saihatanw waahidatan taa khuzuhum wa hum yakhissimoon
verses.translation: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةًۭ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.translit: Falaa yastatee'oona taw siyatanw-wa laaa ilaaa ahlihim yarji'oon
verses.translation: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
verses.translit: Wa nufikha fis-soori faizaa hum minal ajdaasi ilaa Rabbihim yansiloon
verses.translation: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.translit: Qaaloo yaa wailanaa mam ba'asanaa mim marqadinaa; haaza maa wa'adar Rahmanu wa sadaqal mursaloon
verses.translation: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
verses.translit: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum jamee'ul ladainaa muhdaroon
verses.translation: It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translit: Fal-Yawma laa tuzlamu nafsun shai'anw-wa laa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon
verses.translation: This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَٰكِهُونَ
verses.translit: Inna Ashaabal jannatil Yawma fee shughulin faakihoon
verses.translation: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
verses.translit: Hum wa azwaajuhum fee zilaalin 'alal araaa'iki muttaki'oon
verses.translation: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
verses.translit: Lahum feehaa faakiha tunw-wa lahum maa yadda'oon
verses.translation: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْلًۭا مِّن رَّبٍّۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Salaamun qawlam mir Rabbir Raheem
verses.translation: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱمْتَٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.translit: Wamtaazul Yawma ayyuhal mujrimoon
verses.translation: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Alam a'had ilaikum yaa Baneee Aadama al-laa ta'budush Shaitaana innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen
verses.translation: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe! -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa ani'budoonee; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem
verses.translation: But that ye worship Me? That was the right path.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّۭا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.translit: Wa laqad adalla minkum jibillan kaseeraa; afalam takoonoo ta'qiloon
verses.translation: Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
verses.translit: Haazihee Jahannamul latee kuntum too'adoon
verses.translation: This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verses.translit: Islawhal Yawma bimaa kuntum takfuroon
verses.translation: Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.translit: Al-Yawma nakhtimu 'alaaa afwaahihim wa tukallimunaaa aideehim wa tashhadu arjuluhum bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
verses.translation: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa law nashaaa'u lata masna 'alaaa aiyunihim fasta baqus-siraata fa-annaa yubsiroon
verses.translation: And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight so that they should struggle for the way. Then how could they have seen?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّۭا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.translit: Wa law nashaaa'u lamasakhnaahum 'alaa makaanatihim famas-tataa'oo mudiyyanw-wa laa yarji'oon
verses.translation: And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place, making them powerless to go forward or turn back.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.translit: Wa man nu 'ammirhu nunakkishu fil-khalq; afalaa ya'qiloon
verses.translation: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa maa 'allamnaahush shi'ra wa maa yambaghee lah; in huwa illaa zikrunw-wa Qur-aanum mubeen
verses.translation: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّۭا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.translit: Liyunzira man kaana haiyanw-wa yahiqqal qawlu 'alal-kaafireen
verses.translation: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
verses.translit: Awalam yaraw annaa khalaqnaa lahum mimmaa 'amilat aideenaaa an'aaman fahum lahaa maalikoon
verses.translation: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
verses.translit: Wa zallalnaahaa lahum faminhaa rakoobuhum wa minhaa yaakuloon
verses.translation: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa lahum feehaa manaa fi'u wa mashaarib; afalaa yashkuroon
verses.translation: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.translit: Wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal la'allahum yunsaroon
verses.translation: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّحْضَرُونَ
verses.translit: Laa yastatee'oona nasrahum wa hum lahum jundum muhdaroon
verses.translation: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
verses.translit: Falaa yahzunka qawluhum; innaa na'lamu maa yusirroona wa maa yu'linoon
verses.translation: So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Awalam yaral insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min nutfatin fa-izaa huwa khaseemum mubeen
verses.translation: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًۭا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa daraba lanaa maslanw-wa nasiya khalqahoo qaala mai-yuhyil'izaama wa hiya rameem
verses.translation: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.translit: Qul yuh yeehal lazeee ansha ahaaa awwala marrah; wa Huwa bikulli khalqin 'Aleem
verses.translation: Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًۭا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
verses.translit: Allazee ja'ala lakum minash shajaril akhdari naaran fa-izaaa antum minhu tooqidoon
verses.translation: Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.translit: Awa laisal lazee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda biqaadirin 'alaaa ai-yakhluqa mislahum; balaa wa Huwal Khallaaqul 'Aleem
verses.translation: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.translit: Innamaa amruhooo izaaa araada shai'an ai-yaqoola lahoo kun fa-yakoon
verses.translation: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.translit: Fa Subhaanal lazee biyadihee malakootu kulli shai-inw-wa ilaihi turja'oon
verses.translation: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفًّۭا
verses.translit: Wassaaaffaati saffaa
verses.translation: By those who set the ranks in battle order
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًۭا
verses.translit: Fazzaajiraati zajraa
verses.translation: And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
verses.translit: Fattaaliyaati Zikra
verses.translation: And those who read (the Word) for a reminder,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌۭ
verses.translit: Inna Illaahakum la Waahid
verses.translation: Lo! thy Lord is surely One;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ
verses.translit: Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa wa Rabbul mashaariq
verses.translation: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
verses.translit: Innaa zaiyannas samaaa 'ad dunyaa bizeenatinil kawaakib
verses.translation: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَحِفْظًۭا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ مَّارِدٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa hifzam min kulli Shaitaanim maarid
verses.translation: With security from every froward devil.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍۢ
verses.translit: Laa yassamma 'oona ilal mala il a'alaa wa yuqzafoona min kulli jaanib
verses.translation: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: دُحُورًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ وَاصِبٌ
verses.translit: Duhooranw wa lahum 'azaabunw waasib
verses.translation: Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ ثَاقِبٌۭ
verses.translit: Illaa man khatifal khatfata fa atba'ahoo shihaabun saaqib
verses.translation: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍۢ لَّازِبٍۭ
verses.translit: Fastaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqnaa; innaa khalaqnaahum min teenil laazib
verses.translation: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
verses.translit: Bal'ajibta wa yaskharoon
verses.translation: Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa izaa zukkiroo laa yazkuroon
verses.translation: And heed not when they are reminded,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa izaa ra aw Aayatinw yastaskhiroon
verses.translation: And seek to scoff when they behold a portent.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
verses.translit: Wa qaalooo in haazaa illaa sihrum mubeen
verses.translation: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
verses.translit: 'A-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa 'izaaman 'ainnaa lamab'oosoon
verses.translation: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verses.translit: Awa aabaa'unal awwaloon
verses.translation: And our forefathers?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
verses.translit: Qul na'am wa antum daakhiroon
verses.translation: Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.translit: Fa innamaa hiya zajra tunw waahidatun fa izaa hum yanzuroon
verses.translation: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.translit: Qa qaaloo yaa wailanaa haazaa Yawmud-Deen
verses.translation: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translit: Haazaa Yawmul Faslil lazee kuntum bihee tukaziboon
verses.translation: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
verses.translit: Uhshurul lazeena zalamoo wa azwaajahum wa maa kaanoo ya'budoon
verses.translation: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.translit: Min doonil laahi fahdoohum ilaa siraatil Jaheem
verses.translation: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ
verses.translit: Wa qifoohum innahum mas'ooloon
verses.translation: And stop them, for they must be questioned.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
verses.translit: Maa lakum laa tanaasaroon
verses.translation: What aileth you that ye help not one another?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
verses.translit: Bal humul Yawma mustaslimoon
verses.translation: Nay, but this day they make full submission.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.translit: Wa aqbala ba'duhum 'alaa ba'diny yatasaaa'aloon
verses.translation: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.translit: Qaalooo innakum kuntum taatoonanaa 'anil yameen
verses.translation: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Qaaloo bal lam takoonoo mu'mineen
verses.translation: They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا طَٰغِينَ
verses.translit: Wa maa kaana lanaa 'alaikum min sultaanim bal kuntum qawman taagheen
verses.translation: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
verses.translit: Fahaqqa 'alainaa qawlu Rabbinaaa innaa lazaaa'iqoon
verses.translation: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَغْوَيْنَٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ
verses.translit: Fa aghwainaakum innaa kunnaa ghaaween
verses.translation: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
verses.translit: Fa innahum Yawma'izin fil'azaabi mushtarikoon
verses.translation: Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.translit: Innaa kazaalika naf'alu bil mujrimeen
verses.translation: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
verses.translit: Innahum kaanooo izaa qeela lahum laaa ilaaha illal laahu yastakbiroon
verses.translation: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍۢ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
verses.translit: Wa yaqooloona a'innaa lataarikooo aalihatinaa lishaa'irim majnoon
verses.translation: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.translit: bal jaaa'a bilhaqqi wa saddaqal mursaleen
verses.translation: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ
verses.translit: Innakum lazaaa'iqul 'azaabil aleem
verses.translation: Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translit: Wa maa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon
verses.translation: Ye are requited naught save what ye did -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.translit: Illaa 'ibaadal laahil mukhlaseen
verses.translation: Save single-minded slaves of Allah;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
verses.translit: Ulaaa'ika lahum rizqum ma'loom
verses.translation: For them there is a known provision,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
verses.translit: Fa waakihu wa hum mukramoon
verses.translation: Fruits. And they will be honoured
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.translit: Fee jannaatin Na'eem
