verses.translation: In the Gardens of delight,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
verses.translit: 'Alaa sururim mutaqaa bileen
verses.translation: On couches facing one another;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ
verses.translit: Yutaafu 'alaihim bikaasim mim ma'een
verses.translation: A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍۢ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ
verses.translit: Baidaaa'a laz zatil lish shaaribeen
verses.translation: White, delicious to the drinkers,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌۭ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
verses.translit: Laa feehaa ghawlunw wa laa hum 'anhaa yunzafoon
verses.translation: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa 'indahum qaasiraatut tarfi 'een
verses.translation: And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ
verses.translit: Ka annahunna baidum maknoon
verses.translation: (Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.translit: Fa aqbala ba'duhum 'alaa badiny yatasaaa 'aloon
verses.translation: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Qaala qaaa'ilum minhum innee kaana lee qareen
verses.translation: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ
verses.translit: Yaqoolu a'innnaka laminal musaddiqeen
verses.translation: Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
verses.translit: 'A-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa 'izaaman 'ainnaa lamadeenoon
verses.translation: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
verses.translit: Qaala hal antum muttali'oon
verses.translation: He saith: Will ye look?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.translit: Fattala'a fara aahu fee sawaaa'il Jaheem
verses.translation: Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
verses.translit: Qaala tallaahi in kitta laturdeen
verses.translation: He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
verses.translit: Wa law laa ni'matu Rabbee lakuntu minal muhdareen
verses.translation: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
verses.translit: Afamaa nahnu bimaiyiteen
verses.translation: Are we then not to die
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.translit: Illa mawtatanal oola wa maa nahnu bimu'azzabeen
verses.translation: Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.translit: Inna haazaa falya'ma lil'aamiloon
verses.translation: Lo! this is the supreme triumph.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَٰمِلُونَ
verses.translit: Limisli haaza falya'ma lil 'aamiloon
verses.translation: For the like of this, then, let the workers work.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.translit: Azaalika khairun nuzulan am shajaratuz Zaqqom
verses.translation: Is this better as a welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهَا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.translit: Innaa ja'alnaahaa fitnatal lizzaalimeen
verses.translation: Lo! We have appointed it a torment for wrong-doers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌۭ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.translit: Innahaa shajaratun takhruju feee aslil Jaheem
verses.translation: Lo! it is a tree that springeth in the heart of hell.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
verses.translit: Tal'uhaa ka annahoo ru'oosush Shayaateen
verses.translation: Its crop is as it were the heads of devils
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
verses.translit: Fa innahum la aakiloona minhaa famaali'oona minhal butoon
verses.translation: And lo! they verily must eat thereof, and fill (their) bellies therewith.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًۭا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Summa inna lahum 'alaihaa lashawbam min hameem
verses.translation: And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.translit: Summa inna marji'ahum la ilal Jaheem
verses.translation: And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
verses.translit: Innahum alfaw aabaaa'ahum daaalleen
verses.translation: They indeed found their fathers astray,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
verses.translit: Fahum 'alaa aasaarihim yuhra'oon
verses.translation: But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translit: Wa laqad dalla qablahum aksarul awwaleen
verses.translation: And verily most of the men of old went astray before them,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
verses.translit: Wa laqad arsalnaa feehim munzireen
verses.translation: And verily We sent among them warners.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.translit: Fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul munzareen
verses.translation: Then see the nature of the consequence for those warned,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.translit: Illaa 'ibaadal laahil mukhlaseen
verses.translation: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌۭ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
verses.translit: Wa laqad naadaanaa Noohun falani'mal mujeeboon
verses.translation: And Noah verily prayed unto Us, and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.translit: Wa jajainaahu wa ahlahoo minal karbil 'azeem
verses.translation: And We saved him and his household from the great distress,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
verses.translit: Wa ja'alnaa zurriyyatahoo hummul baaqeen
verses.translation: And made his seed the survivors,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verses.translit: Wa taraknaa 'alaihi fil aakhireen
verses.translation: And left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍۢ فِى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Salaamun 'alaa Noohin fil 'aalameen
verses.translation: Peace be unto Noah among the peoples!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.translit: Innaa kazaalika najzil muhsineen
verses.translation: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Innahoo min 'ibaadinal mu'mineen
verses.translation: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
verses.translit: Summa aghraqnal aakhareen
verses.translation: Then We did drown the others.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.translit: Wa ina min shee'atihee la Ibraaheem
verses.translation: And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍ
verses.translit: Iz jaaa'a Rabbahoo bi qalbin saleem
verses.translation: When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.translit: Iz qaala li abeehi wa qawmihee maazaa ta'budoon
verses.translation: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةًۭ دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
verses.translit: A'ifkan aalihatan doonal laahi tureedoon
verses.translation: Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Famaa zannukum bi Rabbil'aalameen
verses.translation: What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةًۭ فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.translit: Fanazara nazratan finnujoom
verses.translation: And he glanced a glance at the stars
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Faqaala inee saqeem
verses.translation: Then said: Lo! I feel sick!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
verses.translit: Fatawallaw 'anhu mudbireen
verses.translation: And they turned their backs and went away from him.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.translit: Faraagha ilaaa aalihatihim faqaala alaa taakuloon
verses.translation: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
verses.translit: Maa lakum laa tantiqoon
verses.translation: What aileth you that ye speak not?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.translit: Faraagha 'alaihim darbam bilyameen
verses.translation: Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
verses.translit: Fa aqbalooo ilaihi yaziffoon
verses.translation: And (his people) came toward him, hastening.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
verses.translit: Qaala ata'budoona maa tanhitoon
verses.translation: He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translit: Wallaahu khalaqakum wa maa ta'maloon
verses.translation: When Allah hath created you and what ye make?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.translit: Qaalub noo lahoo bun yaanan fa alqoohu fil jaheem
verses.translation: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًۭا فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
verses.translit: Fa araadoo bihee kaidan faja 'alnaahumul asfaleen
verses.translation: And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.translit: Wa qaala innee zaahibun ilaa Rabbee sa yahdeen
verses.translation: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.translit: Rabbi hab lee minas saaliheen
verses.translation: My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ حَلِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Fabashsharnaahu bighulaamin haleem
verses.translation: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
verses.translit: Falamma balagha ma'a hus sa'ya qaala yaa buniya inneee araa fil manaami anneee azbahuka fanzur maazaa taraa; qaala yaaa abatif 'al maa tu'maru satajidunee in shaaa'allaahu minas saabireen
verses.translation: And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
verses.translit: Falammaaa aslamaa wa tallahoo liljabeen
verses.translation: Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah), and he had flung him down upon his face,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ أَن يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
verses.translit: Wa naadainaahu ai yaaaa Ibraheem
verses.translation: We called unto him: O Abraham!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.translit: Qad saddaqtar ru'yaa; innaa kazaalika najzil muhsineen
verses.translation: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.translit: Inna haazaa lahuwal balaaa'ul mubeen
verses.translation: Lo! that verily was a clear test.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَفَدَيْنَٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa fadainaahu bizibhin 'azeem
verses.translation: Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verses.translit: Wa taraknaa 'alaihi fil aakhireen
verses.translation: And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.translit: Salaamun 'alaaa Ibraaheem
verses.translation: Peace be unto Abraham!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.translit: Kazaalika najzil muhsineen
verses.translation: Thus do We reward the good.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Innahoo min 'ibaadinal mu'mineen
verses.translation: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِإِسْحَٰقَ نَبِيًّۭا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
verses.translit: Wa bashsharnaahu bi Ishaaqa Nabiyayam minas saaliheen
verses.translation: And we gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a prophet of the righteous.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَبَٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌۭ وَظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa baaraknaa 'alaihi wa 'alaaa Ishaaq; wa min zurriyya tihimaa muhsinunw wa zaalimul linafshihee mubeen
verses.translation: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa laqad mananna alaa Moosaa wa Haaroon
verses.translation: And We verily gave grace unto Moses and Aaron,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.translit: Wa najjainaahumaa wa qawmahumaa minal karbil 'azeem
verses.translation: And saved them and their people from the great distress,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَنَصَرْنَٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
verses.translit: Wa nasarnaahum fakaanoo humul ghaalibeen
verses.translation: And helped them so that they became the victors.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
verses.translit: Wa aatainaahumal Kitaabal mustabeen
verses.translation: And We gave them the clear Scripture
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
verses.translit: Wa hadainaahumus Siraatal Mustaqeem
verses.translation: And showed them the right path.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verses.translit: Wa taraknaa 'alaihimaa fil aakhireen
verses.translation: And We left for them among the later folk (the salutation):
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
verses.translit: Salaamun 'alaa Moosaa wa Haaroon
verses.translation: Peace be unto Moses and Aaron!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.translit: Innaa kazaalika najzil muhsineen
verses.translation: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Innahumaa min 'ibaadinal mu'mineen
verses.translation: Lo! they are two of Our believing slaves.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.translit: Wa inna Ilyaasa laminal mursaleen
verses.translation: And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn),
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.translit: Iz qaala liqawmiheee alaa tattaqoon
verses.translation: When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًۭا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ
verses.translit: Atad'oona Ba'lanw wa tazaroona ahsanal khaaliqeen
verses.translation: Will ye cry unto Baal and forsake the Best of creators,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translit: Allaaha Rabbakum wa Rabba aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen
verses.translation: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
verses.translit: Fakazzaboohu fa inna hum lamuhdaroon
verses.translation: But they denied him, so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.translit: Illaa 'ibaadal laahil mukhlaseen
verses.translation: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verses.translit: Wa taraknaa 'alaihi fil aakhireen
verses.translation: And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
verses.translit: Salaamun 'alaaa Ilyaaseen
verses.translation: Peace be unto Elias!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.translit: Innaa kazaalika najzil muhsineen
verses.translation: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Innahoo min 'ibaadinal mu'mineen
verses.translation: Lo! he is one of our believing slaves.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ لُوطًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.translit: Wa inna Lootal laminal mursaleen
verses.translation: And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.translit: Iz najjainaahu wa ahlahooo ajma'een
verses.translation: When We saved him and his household, every one,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا عَجُوزًۭا فِى ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
verses.translit: Illaa 'ajoozan fil ghaabireen
verses.translation: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
verses.translit: Summa dammarnal aakhareen
verses.translation: Then We destroyed the others.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
verses.translit: Wa innakum latamurroona 'alaihim musbiheen
verses.translation: And lo! ye verily pass by (the ruin of) them in the morning
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.translit: Wa billail; afalaa ta'qiloon
verses.translation: And at night-time; have ye then no sense?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.translit: Wa inna Yoonusa laminal mursaleen
verses.translation: And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verses.translit: Iz abaqa ilal fulkil mash hoon
verses.translation: When he fled unto the laden ship,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
verses.translit: Fasaahama fakaana minal mudhadeen
verses.translation: And then drew lots and was of those rejected;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Faltaqamahul hootu wa huwa muleem
verses.translation: And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
verses.translit: Falaw laaa annahoo kaana minal musabbiheen
verses.translation: And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.translit: Lalabisa fee batniheee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon
verses.translation: He would have tarried in its belly till the day when they are raised;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Fanabaznaahu bil'araaa'i wa huwa saqeem
verses.translation: Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةًۭ مِّن يَقْطِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa ambatnaa 'alaihi shajaratam mai yaqteen
verses.translation: And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
verses.translit: Wa arsalnaahu ilaa mi'ati alfin aw yazeedoon
verses.translation: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Fa aamanoo famatta' naahum ilaa heen
verses.translation: And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verses.translit: Fastaftihim ali Rabbikal banaatu wa lahumul banoon
verses.translation: Now ask them (O Muhammad): Hath thy Lord daughters whereas they have sons?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثًۭا وَهُمْ شَٰهِدُونَ
verses.translit: Am khalaqnal malaaa'i kata inaasanw wa hm shaahidoon
verses.translation: Or created We the angels females while they were present?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.translit: Alaaa innahum min ifkihim la yaqooloon
verses.translation: Lo! it is of their falsehood that they say:
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
verses.translit: Waladal laahu wa innhum lakaaziboon
verses.translation: Allah hath begotten. Allah! verily they tell a lie.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
verses.translit: Astafal banaati 'alal baneen
verses.translation: (And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
verses.translit: Maa lakum kaifa tahkumoon
verses.translation: What aileth you? How judge ye?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.translit: Afalaa tazakkaroon
verses.translation: Will ye not then reflect?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَٰنٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Am lakum sultaanum mubeen
verses.translation: Or have ye a clear warrant?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.translit: Faatoo bi Kitaabikum in kuntum saadiqeen
verses.translation: Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًۭا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa ja'aloo bainahoo wa bainal jinnati nasabaa; wa laqad 'alimatil jinnatu innahum lamuhdaroon
verses.translation: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.translit: Subhaanal laahi 'ammaa yasifoon
verses.translation: Glorified be Allah from that which they attribute (unto Him),
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.translit: Illaa 'ibaadal laahil mukhlaseen
verses.translation: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.translit: Fa innakum wa maa ta'ubdoon
verses.translation: Lo! verily, ye and that which ye worship,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَٰتِنِينَ
verses.translit: Maaa antum 'alaihi befaaatineen
verses.translation: Ye cannot excite (anyone) against Him.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.translit: Illaa man huwa saalil jaheem
verses.translation: Save him who is to burn in hell.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa maa minnasa illaa lahoo maqaamum ma'loom
verses.translation: There is not one of us but hath his known position.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
verses.translit: Wa innaa llanah nus saaffoon
verses.translation: Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
verses.translit: Wa innaa lanah nul musabbihoon
verses.translation: Lo! we, even we are they who hymn His praise
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.translit: Wa in kaanoo la yaqooloon
verses.translation: And indeed they used to say:
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translit: Law anna 'indana zikram minal awwaleen
verses.translation: If we had but a reminder from the men of old
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.translit: Lakunna 'ibaadal laahil mukhlaseen
verses.translation: We would be single-minded slaves of Allah.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translit: Fakafaroo bihee fasawfa ya'lamoon
verses.translation: Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.translit: Wa laqad sabaqat Kalimatunaa li'ibaadinal mursa leen
verses.translation: And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
verses.translit: Innaa hum lahumul mansooroon
verses.translation: That they verily would be helped,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
verses.translit: Wa inna jundana lahumul ghaaliboon
verses.translation: And that Our host, they verily would be the victors.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Fatawalla 'anhum hatta heen
verses.translation: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa absirhum fasawfa yubsiroon
verses.translation: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.translit: Afabi'azaabinaa yasta'jiloon
verses.translation: Would they hasten on Our doom?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.translit: Fa izaa nazala bisaahatihim fasaaa'a sabaahul munzareen
verses.translation: But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa tawalla 'anhum hattaa heen
verses.translation: Withdraw from them awhile
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa absir fasawfa yubsiroon
verses.translation: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.translit: Subhaana Rabbika Rabbil 'izzati 'amma yasifoon
verses.translation: Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.translit: Wa salaamun 'alalmursaleen
verses.translation: And peace be unto those sent (to warn).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Walhamdu lillaahi Rabbil 'aalameen
verses.translation: And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
verses.translit: Saaad; wal-Qur-aani ziz zikr
verses.translation: Sad. By the renowned Qur'an,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍۢ وَشِقَاقٍۢ
verses.translit: Balil lazeena kafaroo fee 'izzatilnw wa shiqaaq
verses.translation: Nay, but those who disbelieve are in false pride and schism.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍۢ
verses.translit: Kam ahlaknaa min qablihim min qarnin fanaadaw wa laata heena manaas
verses.translation: How many a generation We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٌۭ كَذَّابٌ
verses.translit: Wa 'ajibooo an jaaa'a hum munzirum minhum wa qaalal kaafiroona haazaa saahirun kazzaab
verses.translation: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْءَالِهَةَ إِلَٰهًۭا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌۭ
verses.translit: Aja'alal aalihata Ilaahanw Waahidan inna haazaa lashai'un 'ujaab
verses.translation: Maketh he the gods One Allah? Lo! that is an astounding thing.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌۭ يُرَادُ
verses.translit: Wantalaqal mala-u minhum anim shoo wasbiroo 'alaaa aalihatikum innna haazaa lashai 'uny yuraad
verses.translation: The chiefs among them go about, exhorting: Go and be staunch to your gods! Lo! this is a thing designed.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَٰقٌ
verses.translit: Maa sami'naa bihaazaa fil millatil aakhirati in haazaaa illakh tilaaq
verses.translation: We have not heard of this in later religion. This is naught but an invention.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
verses.translit: 'A-unzila 'alaihiz zikru mim baininaa; bal hum fee shakkim min Zikree bal lammaa yazooqoo 'azaab
verses.translation: Hath the reminder been unto him (alone) among us? Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My reminder; nay but they have not yet tasted My doom.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
verses.translit: Am'indahum khazaaa 'inu rahmati Rabbikal 'Azeezil Wahhab
verses.translation: Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَٰبِ
verses.translit: Am lahum mulkus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa falyartaqoo fil asbaab
verses.translation: Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs? Then let them ascend by ropes!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: جُندٌۭ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
verses.translit: Jundum maa hunaalika mahzoomum minal Ahzaab
verses.translation: A defeated host are (all) the factions that are there.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
verses.translit: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Lootinw-wa 'Aadunw wa Fir'awnu zul awtaad
verses.translation: The folk of Noah before them denied (their messenger) and (so did the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh firmly planted,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
verses.translit: Wa Samoodu wa qawmu Lootinw wa Ashaabul 'Aykah; ulaaa'ikal Ahzaab
verses.translation: And (the tribe of) Thamud, and the folk of Lot, and the dwellers in the wood: these were the factions.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
verses.translit: In kullun illaa kazzabar Rusula fahaqqa 'iqaab
verses.translation: Not one of them but did deny the messengers, therefor My doom was justified,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa maa yanzuru haaa ulaaa'i illaa saihatanw waahidatam maa lahaa min fawaaq
verses.translation: These wait for but one Shout, there will be no second thereto.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.translit: Wa qaaloo Rabbanaa 'ajjil lanaa qittanaa qabla Yawmil Hisaab
verses.translation: They say: Our Lord! Hasten on for us our fate before the Day of Reckoning.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.translit: Isbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wazkur 'abdanaa Daawooda zal aidi aidi innahooo awwaab
verses.translation: Bear with what they say, and remember Our bondman David, lord of might, Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verses.translit: Innaa sakhkharnal jibaala ma'ahoo yusabbihna bil'ashaiyi wal ishraaq
verses.translation: Lo! We subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةًۭ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ
verses.translit: Wattayra mahshoorah; kullul lahooo awwaab
verses.translation: And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
verses.translit: Wa shadadnaa mulkahoo wa aatainaahul Hikmata wa faslal khitaab
verses.translation: We made his kingdom strong and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
verses.translit: Wa hal ataaka naba'ul khasm; iz tasawwarul mihraab
verses.translation: And hath the story of the litigants come unto thee? How they climbed the wall into the royal chamber;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
verses.translit: Iz dakhaloo 'alaa Daawooda fafazi'a minhum qaaloo la takhaf khasmaani baghaa ba'dunaa 'alaa ba'din fahkum bainanaaa bilhaqqi wa laa tushtit wahdinaaa ilaa Sawaaa'is Siraat
verses.translation: How they burst in upon David, and he was afraid of them. They said: Be not afraid! (We are) two litigants, one of whom hath wronged the other, therefor judge aright between us; be not unjust; and show us the fair way.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌۭ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةًۭ وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
verses.translit: Inna haazaaa akhee lahoo tis'unw wa tis'oona na'jatanw wa liya na'jatunw waahidah; faqaala akfilneeha wa 'azzanee filkhitaab
verses.translation: Lo! this my brother hath ninety and nine ewes while I had one ewe; and he said: Entrust it to me, and he conquered me in speech.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًۭا وَأَنَابَ ۩
verses.translit: Qaala laqad zalamaka bisu 'aali na'jatika ilaa ni'aajihee wa inna kaseeram minal khulataaa'i la-yabghee ba'duhum 'alaa ba'din illal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati wa qaleehum maa hum; wa zanna Daawoodu annamaa fatannaahu fastaghrara Rabbahoo wa kharra raaki'anw wa anaab
verses.translation: (David) said: He hath wronged thee in demanding thine ewe in addition to his ewes, and lo! many partners oppress one another, save such as believe and do good works, and they are few. And David guessed that We had tried him, and he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he bowed himself and fell down prostrate and repented.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
verses.translit: Faghafarnaa lahoo zaalik; wa inna lahoo 'indanaa lazulfaa wa husna ma aab
verses.translation: So We forgave him that; and lo! he had access to Our presence and a happy journey's end.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.translit: Yaa Daawoodu innaa ja'alnaaka khaleefatan fil ardi fahkum bainan naasi bilhaqqi wa laa tattabi'il hawaa fayudillaka 'an sabeelil laah; innal lazeena yadilloona 'an sabeelil laah; lahum 'azaabun shadeedum bimaa nasoo Yawmal Hisaab
verses.translation: (And it was said unto him): O David! Lo! We have set thee as a viceroy in the earth; therefor judge aright between mankind, and follow not desire that it beguile thee from the way of Allah. Lo! those who wander from the way of Allah have an awful doom, forasmuch as they forgot the Day of Reckoning.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَٰطِلًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.translit: Wa ma khalaqnas samaaa'a wal arda wa maa bainahumaa baatilaa; zaalika zannul lazeena kafaroo; fawi lul lillazeena kafaroo minan Naar
verses.translation: And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the opinion of those who disbelieve. And woe unto those who disbelieve, from the Fire!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
verses.translit: Am naj'alul lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati kalmufisdeena fil ardi am naj'alul muttaqeena kalfujjaar
verses.translation: Shall We treat those who believe and do good works as those who spread corruption in the earth; or shall We treat the pious as the wicked?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكٌۭ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.translit: Kitaabun anzalnaahu ilaika mubaarakul liyaddabbarooo Aayaatihee wa liyatazakkara ulul albaab
verses.translation: (This is) a Scripture that We have revealed unto thee, full of blessing, that they may ponder its revelations, and that men of understanding may reflect.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.translit: Wa wahabnaa li Daawooda Sulaimaan; ni'mal 'abd; innahoo awwaab
verses.translation: And We bestowed on David, Solomon. How excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
verses.translit: Iz 'urida 'alaihi bil'ashiy yis saafinaatul jiyaad
verses.translation: When there were shown to him at eventide lightfooted coursers
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verses.translit: Faqaala inneee ahbabtu hubbal khairi 'an zikri Rabbee hattaa tawaarat bilhijaab
verses.translation: And he said: Lo! I have preferred the good things (of the world) to the remembrance of my Lord; till they were taken out of sight behind the curtain.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
verses.translit: Ruddoohaa 'alaiya fatafiqa masham bissooqi wal a'naaq
verses.translation: (Then he said): Bring them back to me, and fell to slashing (with his sword their) legs and necks.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًۭا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
verses.translit: Wa laqad fatannaa Sulaimaana wa alqainaa 'alaa kursiyyihee jasadan summa anaab
verses.translation: And verily We tried Solomon, and set upon his throne a (mere) body. Then did he repent.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًۭا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
verses.translit: Qaala Rabbigh fir lee wa hab lee mulkal laa yambaghee li ahadim mim ba'de inaka Antal Wahhab
verses.translation: He said: My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me sovereignty such as shall not belong to any after me. Lo! Thou art the Bestower.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
verses.translit: Fasakhkharnaa lahur reeha tajree bi amrihee rukhaaa'an haisu asaab
verses.translation: So We made the wind subservient unto him, setting fair by his command whithersoever he intended.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍۢ وَغَوَّاصٍۢ
verses.translit: Wash Shayaateena kulla bannaaa'inw wa ghawwaas
verses.translation: And the unruly, every builder and diver (made We subservient),
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
verses.translit: Wa aakhareena muqarraneena fil asfaad
verses.translation: And others linked together in chains,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
verses.translit: Haazaa 'ataaa'unaa famnun aw amsik bighairi hisaab
verses.translation: (Saying): This is Our gift, so bestow thou, or withhold, without reckoning.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa inna lahoo 'indanaa lazulfaa wa husna ma-aab
verses.translation: And lo! he hath favour with Us, and a happy journey's end.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verses.translit: Wazkur 'abdanaaa Ayyoob; iz naada Rabbahooo annee massaniyash Shaitaanu binus binw wa 'azaab
verses.translation: And make mention (O Muhammad) of Our bondman Job, when he cried unto his Lord (saying): Lo! the devil doth afflict me with distress and torment.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
verses.translit: Urkud birijlika haaza mughtasalum baaridunw wa sharaab
verses.translation: (And it was said unto him): Strike the ground with thy foot. This (spring) is a cool bath and a refreshing drink.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.translit: Wa wahabnaa lahoo ahlahoo wa mislahum ma'ahum rahmatam minna wa zikraa li ulil albaab
verses.translation: And We bestowed on him (again) his household and therewith the like thereof, a mercy from Us, and a memorial for men of understanding.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًۭا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِرًۭا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa khuz biyadika dighsan fadrib bihee wa laa tahnas, innaa wajadnaahu saabiraa; ni'mal 'abd; innahooo awwaab
verses.translation: And (it was said unto him): Take in thine hand a branch and smite therewith, and break not thine oath. Lo! We found him steadfast, how excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (to his Lord).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ
verses.translit: Wazkur 'ibaadanaaa Ibraaheema wa Is-haaqa wa Ya'qooba ulil-aydee walabsaar
verses.translation: And make mention of Our bondmen, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of parts and vision.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍۢ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
verses.translit: Innaaa akhlasnaahum bi khaalisatin zikrad daar
verses.translation: Lo! We purified them with a pure thought, remembrance of the Home (of the Hereafter).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verses.translit: Wa innahum 'indanaa laminal mustafainal akhyaar
verses.translation: Lo! in Our sight they are verily of the elect, the excellent.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verses.translit: Wazkur Ismaa'eela wal Yasa'a wa Zal-Kifli wa kullum minal akhyaar
verses.translation: And make mention of Ishmael and Elisha and Dhu'l-Kifl. All are of the chosen.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَٰذَا ذِكْرٌۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
verses.translit: Haazaa zikr; wa inna lilmuttaqeena lahusna ma aab
verses.translation: This is a reminder. And lo! for those who ward off (evil) is a happy journey's end,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍۢ مُّفَتَّحَةًۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
verses.translit: Jannaati 'adnim mufat tahatal lahumul abwaab
verses.translation: Gardens of Eden, whereof the gates are opened for them,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ وَشَرَابٍۢ
verses.translit: Muttaki'eena feehaa yad'oona feehaa bifaakihatin kaseeratinw wa sharaab
verses.translation: Wherein, reclining, they call for plenteous fruit and cool drink (that is) therein.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
verses.translit: Wa 'indahum qaasiraatut tarfi atraab
verses.translation: And with them are those of modest gaze, companions.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.translit: Haaza maa too'odoona li Yawmil Hisaab
verses.translation: This it is that ye are promised for the Day of Reckoning.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
verses.translit: Inna haazaa larizqunaa maa lahoo min nafaad
verses.translation: Lo! this in truth is Our provision, which will never waste away.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍۢ
verses.translit: Haazaa; wa inna littaagheena lasharra ma-aab
verses.translation: This (is for the righteous). And lo! for the transgressors there with be an evil journey's end,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
verses.translit: Jahannama yaslawnahaa fai'sal mihaad
verses.translation: Hell, where they will burn, an evil resting-place.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌۭ وَغَسَّاقٌۭ
verses.translit: Haazaa falyazooqoohu hameemunw wa ghassaaq
verses.translation: Here is a boiling and an ice-cold draught, so let them taste it,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
verses.translit: Wa aakharu min shak liheee azwaaj
verses.translation: And other (torment) of the kind in pairs (the two extremes)!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌۭ مُّقْتَحِمٌۭ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.translit: Haazaa fawjum muqtahimum ma'akum laa marhabam bihim; innahum saalun Naar
verses.translation: Here is an army rushing blindly with you. (Those who are already in the Fire say): No word of welcome for them. Lo! they will roast at the Fire.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
verses.translit: Qaaloo bal antum laa marhabam bikum; antum qaddamtumoohu lanaa fabi'sal qaraar
verses.translation: They say: Nay, but you (misleaders), for you there is no word of welcome. Ye prepared this for us (by your misleading). Now hapless is the plight.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًۭا ضِعْفًۭا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
verses.translit: Qaaloo Rabbanaa man qaddama lanaa haaza fazidhu 'azaaban di'fan fin Naar
verses.translation: They say: Our Lord! Whoever did prepare this for us, oh, give him double portion of the Fire!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًۭا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
verses.translit: Wa qaaloo ma lanaa laa naraa rijaalan kunnaa na'udduhum minal ashraar
verses.translation: And they say: What aileth us that we behold not men whom we were wont to count among the wicked?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَتَّخَذْنَٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
verses.translit: Attakhaznaahum sikh riyyan am zaaghat 'anhumul absaar
verses.translation: Did we take them (wrongly) for a laughing-stock, or have our eyes missed them?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّۭ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.translit: Inna zaalika lahaqqun takhaasumu Ahlin Naar
verses.translation: Lo! that is very truth: the wrangling of the dwellers in the Fire.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌۭ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
verses.translit: Qul innamaaa ana munzirunw wa maa min ilaahim illal laahul Waahidul Qahhaar
verses.translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I am only a warner, and there is no Allah save Allah, the One, the Absolute,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
verses.translit: Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumal 'Azeezul Ghaffaar
verses.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Mighty, the Pardoning.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
verses.translit: Qul huwa naba'un 'azeem
verses.translation: Say: It is tremendous tidings
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.translit: Antum 'anhu mu'ridoon
verses.translation: Whence ye turn away!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.translit: Maa kaana liya min 'ilmim bilmala il a'laaa iz yakhtasimoon
verses.translation: I had no knowledge of the Highest Chiefs when they disputed;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
verses.translit: Iny-yoohaaa ilaiya illaaa annnamaaa ana nazeerum mubeen
verses.translation: It is revealed unto me only that I may be a plain warner.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن طِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Iz qaala Rabbuka lilmalaaa'ikati innee khaaliqum basharam min teen
verses.translation: When thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to create a mortal out of mire,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
verses.translit: Fa-iza sawwaituhoo wa nafakhtu feehi mir roohee faqa'oo lahoo saajideen
verses.translation: And when I have fashioned him and breathed into him of My Spirit, then fall down before him prostrate,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.translit: Fasajadal malaaa'ikatu kulluhum ajma'oon
verses.translation: The angels fell down prostrate, every one,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.translit: Illaaa Iblees; istakbara wa kaana minal kaafireen
verses.translation: Saving Iblis; he was scornful and became one of the disbelievers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
verses.translit: Qaala yaaa Ibleesu maa man'aka an tasjuda limaa khalaqtu biyadai; astakbarta am kunta min 'aaleen
verses.translation: He said: O Iblis! What hindereth thee from falling prostrate before that which I have created with both My hands? Art thou too proud or art thou of the high exalted?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍۢ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Qaala ana khairum minah; khalaqtanee min naarinw wa khalaqtahoo min teen
verses.translation: He said: I am better than him. Thou createdst me of fire, whilst him Thou didst create of clay.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Qaala fakhruj minhaa fainnaka rajeem
verses.translation: He said: Go forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.translit: Wa inna 'alaika la'nateee ilaa Yawmid Deen
verses.translation: And lo! My curse is on thee till the Day of Judgment.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.translit: Qaala Rabbi fa anzirneee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon
verses.translation: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verses.translit: Qaala fa innaka minal munzareen
verses.translation: He said: Lo! thou art of those reprieved
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
verses.translit: Ilaa Yawmil waqtil ma'loom
verses.translation: Until the day of the time appointed.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.translit: Qaala fabi'izzatika la ughwiyannahum ajma'een
verses.translation: He said: Then, by Thy might, I surely will beguile them every one,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.translit: Illaa 'ibaadaka minhumul mukhlaseen
verses.translation: Save Thy single-minded slaves among them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
verses.translit: Qaala falhaqq, walhaqqa aqool
verses.translation: He said: The Truth is, and the Truth I speak,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.translit: La amla'annna Jahannama minka wa mimman tabi'aka minhum ajma'een
verses.translation: That I shall fill hell with thee and with such of them as follow thee, together.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍۢ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
verses.translit: Qul maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrinw wa maaa ana minal mutakallifeen
verses.translation: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee for this, and I am no simulating.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: In huwa illaa zikrul lil'aalameen
verses.translation: Lo! it is naught else than a reminder for all peoples
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
verses.translit: Wa lata'lamunna naba ahoo ba'da heen
verses.translation: And ye will come in time to know the truth thereof.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.translit: Tanzeelul Kitaabi minal laahil 'Azeezil Hakeem
verses.translation: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَٱعْبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
verses.translit: Innaaa anzalnaaa ilaikal Kitaaba bilhaqqi fa'budil laaha mukhlisal lahud deen
verses.translation: Lo! We have revealed the Scripture unto thee (Muhammad) with truth; so worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْخَالِصُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِى مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ كَٰذِبٌۭ كَفَّارٌۭ
verses.translit: Alaa lillaahid deenul khaalis; wallazeenat takhazoo min dooniheee awliyaaa'a maa na'buduhum illaa liyuqar riboonaaa ilal laahi zulfaa; innal laaha yahkumu baina hum fee maa hum feehi yakhtalifoon; innal laaha laa yahdee man huwa kaazibun kaffaar
verses.translation: Surely pure religion is for Allah only. And those who choose protecting friends beside Him (say): We worship them only that they may bring us near unto Allah. Lo! Allah will judge between them concerning that wherein they differ. Lo! Allah guideth not him who is a liar, an ingrate.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّوْ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًۭا لَّٱصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
verses.translit: Law araadal laahu aiyattakhiza waladal lastafaa mimmaa yakhluqu maa yashaaa'; Subhaanahoo Huwal laahul Waahidul Qahhaar
verses.translation: If Allah had willed to choose a son, He could have chosen what He would of that which He hath created. Be He Glorified! He is Allah, the One, the Absolute.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
verses.translit: Khalaqas samaawaati wal arda bilhaqq; yukawwirul laila 'alan nahaari wa yukawwirun nahaara 'alaal laili wa sakhkharash shamsa walqamara kulluny yajree li ajalim musammaa; alaa Huwal 'Azeezul Ghaffaar
verses.translation: He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. He maketh night to succeed day, and He maketh day to succeed night, and He constraineth the sun and the moon to give service, each running on for an appointed term. Is not He the Mighty, the Forgiver?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍۢ وَٰحِدَةٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍۢ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًۭا مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍۢ فِى ظُلُمَٰتٍۢ ثَلَٰثٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ
verses.translit: Khalaqakum min nafsinw waahidatin summa ja'ala minhaa zawjahaa wa anzala lakum minal-an'aami samaani yata azwaaj; yakhuluqukum fee butooni ummahaatikum khalqam mim ba'di khalqin fee zulumaatin salaas; zaalikumul laahu Rabbukum lahul mulk; laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa fa annaa tusrafoon
verses.translation: He created you from one being, then from that (being) He made its mate; and He hath provided for you of cattle eight kinds. He created you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, in a threefold gloom. Such is Allah, your Lord. His is the Sovereignty. There is no Allah save Him. How then are ye turned away?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلْكُفْرَ ۖ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا۟ يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.translit: In takfuroo fa innal laaha ghaniyyun 'ankum; wa laa yardaa li'ibaadihil kufra wa in tashkuroo yardahu lakum; wa laa taziru waaziratunw wizra ukhraa; summa ilaa Rabikum marji'ukum fa-yunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon; innahoo 'aleemum bizaatissudoor
verses.translation: If ye are thankless, yet Allah is Independent of you, though He is not pleased with thanklessness for His bondmen; and if ye are thankful He is pleased therewith for you. No laden soul will bear another's load. Then unto your Lord is your return; and He will tell you what ye used to do. Lo! He knoweth what is in the breasts (of men).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعْمَةًۭ مِّنْهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًۭا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.translit: Wa izaa massal insaana durrun da'aa Rabbahoo muneeban ilaihi summa izaa khawwalahoo ni'matam minhu nasiya maa kaana yad'ooo ilaihi min qablu wa ja'ala lillaahi andaadal liyudilla 'ansabeelih; qul tamatta' bikufrika qaleelan innaka min Ashaabin Naar;
verses.translation: And when some hurt toucheth man, he crieth unto his Lord, turning unto Him (repentant). Then, when He granteth him a boon from Him he forgetteth that for which he cried unto Him before, and setteth up rivals to Allah that he may beguile (men) from his way. Say (O Muhammad, unto such an one): Take pleasure in thy disbelief a while. Lo! thou art of the owners of the Fire.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ سَاجِدًۭا وَقَآئِمًۭا يَحْذَرُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوا۟ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِۦ ۗ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.translit: Amman huwa qaanitun aanaaa'al laili saajidanw wa qaaa'imai yahzarul Aakhirata wa yarjoo rahmata Rabbih; qul hal yastawil lazeena ya'lamoona wallazeena laa ya'lamoon; innamaa yatazakkaru ulul albaab
verses.translation: Is he who payeth adoration in the watches of the night, prostrate and standing, bewaring of the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, (to be accounted equal with a disbeliever)? Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Are those who know equal with those who know not? But only men of understanding will pay heed.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌۭ ۗ وَأَرْضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌ ۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
verses.translit: Qul yaa 'ibaadil lazeena aamanut taqoo Rabbakum; lillazeena ahsanoo fee haazihid dunyaa hasanah; wa ardul laahi waasi'ah; innamaa yuwaffas saabiroona ajrahum bighayri hisab
verses.translation: Say: O My bondmen who believe! Observe your duty to your Lord. For those who do good in this world there is good, and Allah's earth is spacious. Verily the steadfast will be paid their wages without stint.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
verses.translit: Qul inneee umirtu an a'budal laaha mukhlisal lahud deen
verses.translation: Say (O Muhammad): Lo! I am commanded to worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.translit: Wa umirtu li an akoona awwalal muslimeen
verses.translation: And I am commanded to be the first of those who are muslims (surrender unto Him).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Qul inneee akhaafu in 'asaitu Rabbee 'azaaba Yawmin 'azeem
verses.translation: Say: Lo! if I should disobey my Lord, I fear the doom of a tremendous Day.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُۥ دِينِى
verses.translit: Qulil laaha a'budu mukhlisal lahoo deenee
verses.translation: Say: Allah I worship, making my religion pure for Him (only).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱعْبُدُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.translit: Fa'budoo maa shi'tum min doonih; qul innal khaasireenal lazeena khasirooo anfusahum wa ahleehim yawmal qiyaamah; alaa zaalika huwal khusraanul mubeen
verses.translation: Then worship what ye will beside Him. Say: The losers will be those who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Ah, that will be the manifest loss!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥ ۚ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
verses.translit: Lahum min fawqihim zulalum minan Naari wa min tahtihim zulal; zaalika yukhaw wiful laahu bihee 'ibaadah; yaa 'ibaadi fattaqoon
verses.translation: They have an awning of fire above them and beneath them a dais (of fire). With this doth Allah appal His bondmen. O My bondmen, therefor fear Me!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَنَبُوا۟ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ ۚ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ
verses.translit: Wallazeenaj tanabut Taaghoota ai ya'budoohaa wa anaabooo ilal laahi lahumul bushraa; fabashshir 'ibaad
verses.translation: And those who put away false gods lest they should worship them and turn to Allah in repentance, for them there are glad tidings. Therefor give good tidings (O Muhammad) to My bondmen
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُۥٓ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.translit: Allazeena yastami'oonal qawla fayattabi'oona ahsanah; ulaaa'ikal lazeena hadaahumul laahu wa ulaaa'ika hum ulul albaab
verses.translation: Who hear advice and follow the best thereof. Such are those whom Allah guideth, and such are men of understanding.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ
verses.translit: Afaman haqqa 'alaihi kalimatul 'azaab; afa anta tunqizu man fin Naar
verses.translation: Is he on whom the word of doom is fulfilled (to be helped), and canst thou (O Muhammad) rescue him who is in the Fire?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌۭ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌۭ مَّبْنِيَّةٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
verses.translit: Laakinil lazeenat taqaw Rabbahum lahum ghurafum min fawqihaa ghurafum mabniyyatun tajree min tahtihal anhaar; wa'dal laah; laa yukhliful laahul mee'aad
verses.translation: But those who keep their duty to their Lord, for them are lofty halls with lofty halls above them, built (for them), beneath which rivers flow. (It is) a promise of Allah. Allah faileth not His promise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًۭا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّۭا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰمًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.translit: Alam tara annal laaha anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an fasalakahoo yanaabee'a fil ardi summa yukhriju bihee zar'am mukhtalifan alwaanuhoo summa yaheeju fatarahu musfarran summa yaj'aluhoo hutaamaa; inna fee zaalika lazikraa li ulil albaab
verses.translation: Hast thou not seen how Allah hath sent down water from the sky and hath caused it to penetrate the earth as watersprings, and afterward thereby produceth crops of divers hues; and afterward they wither and thou seest them turn yellow; then He maketh them chaff. Lo! herein verily is a reminder for men of understanding.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدْرَهُۥ لِلْإِسْلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translit: Afaman sharahal laahu sadrahoo lil Islaami fahuwa 'alaa noorim mir Rabbih; fa wailul lilqaasiyati quloobuhum min zikril laah; ulaaa'ika fee dalaalim mubeen
verses.translation: Is he whose bosom Allah hath expanded for Al-Islam, so that he followeth a light from his Lord, (as he who disbelieveth)? Then woe unto those whose hearts are hardened against remembrance of Allah. Such are in plain error.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ كِتَٰبًۭا مُّتَشَٰبِهًۭا مَّثَانِىَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
verses.translit: Allahu nazzala ahsanal hadeesi Kitaabam mutashaa biham masaaniy taqsha'irru minhu juloodul lazeena yakhshawna Rabbahum summa taleenu julooduhum wa quloo buhum ilaa zikril laah; zaalika hudal laahi yahdee bihee mai yashaaa'; wa mai yudlilil laahu famaa lahoo min haad
verses.translation: Allah hath (now) revealed the fairest of statements, a Scripture consistent, (wherein promises of reward are) paired (with threats of punishment), whereat doth creep the flesh of those who fear their Lord, so that their flesh and their hearts soften to Allah's reminder. Such is Allah's guidance, wherewith He guideth whom He will. And him whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran
