verses.translation: That He may bring the believing men and the believing women into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide, and may remit from them their evil deeds - That, in the sight of Allah, is the supreme triumph -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَيُعَذِّبَ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقَٰتِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ وَٱلْمُشْرِكَٰتِ ٱلظَّآنِّينَ بِٱللَّهِ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ عَلَيْهِمْ دَآئِرَةُ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۖ وَغَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَنَهُمْ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمْ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَسَآءَتْ مَصِيرًۭا
verses.translit: Wa yu'azzibal munaafiqeena walmunaafiqaati wal mushrikeena walmushrikaatiz zaaanneena billaahi zannas saw'; 'alaihim daaa'iratus saw'i wa ghadibal laahu 'alaihim wa la'anahum wa a'adda lahum jahannama wa saaa' at maseeraa
verses.translation: And may punish the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women, and the idolatrous men and the idolatrous women, who think an evil thought concerning Allah. For them is the evil turn of fortune, and Allah is wroth against them and hath cursed them, and hath made ready for them hell, a hapless journey's end.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا
verses.translit: Wa lillaahi junoodus samaawaati wal ard; wa kaanal laahu 'azeezan hakeema
verses.translation: Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Mighty, Wise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ شَٰهِدًۭا وَمُبَشِّرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا
verses.translit: Innaaa arsalnaaka shaahi danw wa mubashshiranw wa nazeera
verses.translation: Lo! We have sent thee (O Muhammad) as a witness and a bearer of good tidings and a warner,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لِّتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًا
verses.translit: Litu minoo billaahi wa Rasoolihee wa tu'azziroohu watuwaqqiroohu watusabbi hoohu bukratanw wa aseelaa
verses.translation: That ye (mankind) may believe in Allah and His messenger, and may honour Him, and may revere Him, and may glorify Him at early dawn and at the close of day.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبَايِعُونَكَ إِنَّمَا يُبَايِعُونَ ٱللَّهَ يَدُ ٱللَّهِ فَوْقَ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۚ فَمَن نَّكَثَ فَإِنَّمَا يَنكُثُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِمَا عَٰهَدَ عَلَيْهُ ٱللَّهَ فَسَيُؤْتِيهِ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًۭا
verses.translit: Innal lazeena yubaayi'oonaka innamaa yubaayi'oonal laaha yadul laahi fawqa aydehim; faman nakasa fainnamaa yuankusu 'alaa nafsihee wa man awfaa bimaa 'aahada 'alihul laaha fasa yu'teehi ajran 'azeemaa
verses.translation: Lo! those who swear allegiance unto thee (Muhammad), swear allegiance only unto Allah. The Hand of Allah is above their hands. So whosoever breaketh his oath, breaketh it only to his soul's hurt; while whosoever keepeth his covenant with Allah, on him will He bestow immense reward.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: سَيَقُولُ لَكَ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ شَغَلَتْنَآ أَمْوَٰلُنَا وَأَهْلُونَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ۚ يَقُولُونَ بِأَلْسِنَتِهِم مَّا لَيْسَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ ۚ قُلْ فَمَن يَمْلِكُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ ضَرًّا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ نَفْعًۢا ۚ بَلْ كَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًۢا
verses.translit: Sa yaqoolu lakal mukhal lafoona minal-A'raabi shaighalatnaaa amwaalunaa wa ahloonaa fastaghfir lanaa; yaqooloona bi alsinatihim maa laisa fee quloobihim; qul famany yamliku lakum minal laahi shai'an in araada bikum darran aw araada bikum naf'aa; bal kaanal laahu bimaa ta'maloona Khabeeraa
verses.translation: Those of the wandering Arabs who were left behind will tell thee: Our possessions and our households occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us! They speak with their tongues that which is not in their hearts. Say: Who can avail you aught against Allah, if He intend you hurt or intend you profit? Nay, but Allah is ever Aware of what ye do.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بَلْ ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَنقَلِبَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِيهِمْ أَبَدًۭا وَزُيِّنَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَظَنَنتُمْ ظَنَّ ٱلسَّوْءِ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًۢا بُورًۭا
verses.translit: Bal zanantum al lany yanqalibar Rasoolu walmu'minoona ilaaa ahleehim abadanw wa zuyyina zaalika fee quloobikum wa zanantum zannnas saw'i wa kuntum qawmam booraa
verses.translation: Nay, but ye deemed that the messenger and the believers would never return to their own folk, and that was made fairseeming in your hearts, and ye did think an evil thought, and ye were worthless folk.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ فَإِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَعِيرًۭا
verses.translit: Wa mal lam yu'mim billaahi wa Rasoolihee fainnaaa a'tadnaa lilkaafireena sa'eeraa
verses.translation: And so for him who believeth not in Allah and His messenger - Lo! We have prepared a flame for disbelievers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا
verses.translit: Wa lillaahii mulkus samaawaati wal ard; yaghfiru limany yashaaa'u wa yu'azzibu many yashaaa'; wa kaanal laahu Ghafoorar Raheemaa
verses.translation: And Allah's is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He forgiveth whom He will, and punisheth whom He will. And Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: سَيَقُولُ ٱلْمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا ٱنطَلَقْتُمْ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأْخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ ۖ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يُبَدِّلُوا۟ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُل لَّن تَتَّبِعُونَا كَذَٰلِكُمْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلْ تَحْسُدُونَنَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verses.translit: Sa yaqoolul mukhalla foona izan talaqtum ilaa maghaanima litaakhuzoohaa zaroonaa nattabi'kum yureedoona any yubaddiloo Kalaamallaah; qul lan tattabi'oonaa kazaalikum qaalal laahu min qablu fasa yaqooloona bal tahsudoonanna; bal kaanoo laa yafqahoona illaa qaleela
verses.translation: Those who were left behind will say, when ye set forth to capture booty: Let us go with you. They fain would change the verdict of Allah. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye shall not go with us. Thus hath Allah said beforehand. Then they will say: Ye are envious of us. Nay, but they understand not, save a little.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُل لِّلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ تُقَٰتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ ۖ فَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ يُؤْتِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَجْرًا حَسَنًۭا ۖ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ كَمَا تَوَلَّيْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
verses.translit: Qul lilmukhallafeena minal A'raabi satud'awna ilaa qawmin ulee baasin shadeedin tuqaati loonahum aw yuslimoona fa in tutee'oo yu'tikumul laahu ajran hasananw wa in tatawallaw kamaa tawallaitum min qablu yu'azzibkum 'azaaban aleemaa
verses.translation: Say unto those of the wandering Arabs who were left behind: Ye will be called against a folk of mighty prowess, to fight them until they surrender; and if ye obey, Allah will give you a fair reward; but if ye turn away as ye did turn away before, He will punish you with a painful doom.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌۭ ۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبْهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
verses.translit: Laisa 'alal a'maa harajunw wa laa 'alal a'raji harajunw wa laa 'alal mareedi haraj' wa many yutil'il laaha wa Rasoolahoo yudkhilhu jannaatin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru wa many yatawalla yu'azzibhu 'azaaban aleemaa
verses.translation: There is no blame for the blind, nor is there blame for the lame, nor is there blame for the sick (that they go not forth to war). And whoso obeyeth Allah and His messenger, He will make him enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow; and whoso turneth back, him will He punish with a painful doom.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ لَّقَدْ رَضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَأَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَثَٰبَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا قَرِيبًۭا
verses.translit: Laqad radiyal laahu 'anil mu'mineena iz yubaayi 'oonaka tahtash shajarati fa'alima maa fee quloobihim fa anzalas sakeenata 'alaihim wa asaa bahum fat han qareebaa
verses.translation: Allah was well pleased with the believers when they swore allegiance unto thee beneath the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, and He sent down peace of reassurance on them, and hath rewarded them with a near victory;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةًۭ يَأْخُذُونَهَا ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًۭا
verses.translit: Wa maghaanima kaseera tany yaakhuzoonahaa; wa kaanal laahu 'Azeezan Hakeemaa
verses.translation: And much booty that they will capture. Allah is ever Mighty, Wise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَعَدَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةًۭ تَأْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَٰذِهِۦ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِىَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنكُمْ وَلِتَكُونَ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَٰطًۭا مُّسْتَقِيمًۭا
verses.translit: Wa'adakumul laahu ma ghaanima kaseeratan taakhuzoo nahaa fa'ajjala lakum haazihee wa kaffa aydiyan naasi 'ankum wa litakoona aayatal lilmu'mineena wa yahdiyakum siraatam mustaqeema
verses.translation: Allah promiseth you much booty that ye will capture, and hath given you this in advance, and hath withheld men's hands from you, that it may be a token for the believers, and that He may guide you on a right path.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا قَدْ أَحَاطَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرًۭا
verses.translit: Wa ukhraa lam taqdiroo 'alaihaa qad ahaatal laahu bihaa; wa kaanal laahu 'alaa kulli shai'in qadeera
verses.translation: And other (gain), which ye have not been able to achieve, Allah will compass it, Allah is Able to do all things.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَوْ قَٰتَلَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوَلَّوُا۟ ٱلْأَدْبَٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّۭا وَلَا نَصِيرًۭا
verses.translit: Wa law qaatalakumul lazeena kafaroo la wallawul adbaara summa laa yajidoona waliyanw-wa laa naseeraa
verses.translation: And if those who disbelieve join battle with you they will take to flight, and afterward they will find no protecting friend nor helper.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًۭا
verses.translit: Sunnatal laahil latee qad khalat min qablu wa lan tajida lisunnatil laahi tabdeelaa
verses.translation: It is the law of Allah which hath taken course aforetime. Thou wilt not find for the law of Allah aught of power to change.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
verses.translit: Wa Huwal lazee kaffa aydiyahum 'ankum wa aydiyakum 'anhum bibatni Makkata mim ba'di an azfarakum 'alaihim; wa kaanal laahu bimaa ta'maloona Baseera
verses.translation: And He it is Who hath withheld men's hands from you, and hath withheld your hands from them, in the valley of Mecca, after He had made you victors over them. Allah is Seer of what ye do.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَٱلْهَدْىَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُۥ ۚ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌۭ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٌۭ مُّؤْمِنَٰتٌۭ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌۢ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ ۖ لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا۟ لَعَذَّبْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.translit: Humul lazeena kafaroo wa saddookum 'anil-Masjidil-Haraami walhadya ma'koofan any yablugha mahillah; wa law laa rijaalum mu'minoona wa nisaaa'um mu'minaatul lam ta'lamoohum an tata'oohum fatuseebakum minhum ma'arratum bighairi 'ilmin liyud khilal laahu fee rahmatihee many yashaaa'; law tazayyaloo la'azzabnal lazeena kafaroo minhum 'azaaban aleema
verses.translation: These it was who disbelieved and debarred you from the Inviolable Place of Worship, and debarred the offering from reaching its goal. And if it had not been for believing men and believing women, whom ye know not - lest ye should tread them under foot and thus incur guilt for them unknowingly; that Allah might bring into His mercy whom He will - If (the believers and the disbelievers) had been clearly separated We verily had punished those of them who disbelieved with painful punishment.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًۭا
verses.translit: Iz ja'alal lazeena kafaroo fee quloobihimul hamiyyata hamiyyatal jaahiliyyati fa anzalal laahu sakeenatahoo 'alaa Rasoolihee wa 'alal mu mineena wa alzamahum kalimatat taqwaa wa kaanooo ahaqqa bihaa wa ahlahaa; wa kaanal laahu bikulli shai'in Aleema
verses.translation: When those who disbelieve had set up in their hearts zealotry, the zealotry of the Age of Ignorance, then Allah sent down His peace of reassurance upon His messenger and upon the believers and imposed on them the word of self-restraint, for they were worthy of it and meet for it. And Allah is Aware of all things.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءْيَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ ۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا۟ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتْحًۭا قَرِيبًا
verses.translit: Laqad sadaqal laahu Rasoolahur ru'yaa bilhaqq, latadkhulunnal Masjidal-Haraama in shaaa'al laahu aamineena muhalliqeena ru'oosakum wa muqassireena laa takhaafoona fa'alima maa lam ta'lamoo faja'ala min dooni zaalika fathan qareebaa
verses.translation: Allah hath fulfilled the vision for His messenger in very truth. Ye shall indeed enter the Inviolable Place of Worship, if Allah will, secure, (having your hair) shaven and cut, not fearing. But He knoweth that which ye know not, and hath given you a near victory beforehand.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۭا
verses.translit: Huwal lazeee arsala Rasoolahoo bilhudaa wa deenil haqqi liyuzhirahoo 'alad deeni kullih; wa kafaa billaahi Shaheeda
verses.translation: He it is Who hath sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, that He may cause it to prevail over all religion. And Allah sufficeth as a Witness.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مُّحَمَّدٌۭ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ تَرَىٰهُمْ رُكَّعًۭا سُجَّدًۭا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًۭا ۖ سِيمَاهُمْ فِى وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلْإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسْتَغْلَظَ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعْجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلْكُفَّارَ ۗ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةًۭ وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًۢا
verses.translit: Muhammadur Rasoolul laah; wallazeena ma'ahooo ashiddaaa'u 'alal kuffaaari ruhamaaa'u bainahum taraahum rukka'an sujjadany yabtaghoona fadlam minal laahi wa ridwaanan seemaahum fee wujoohihim min asaris sujood; zaalika masaluhum fit tawraah; wa masaluhum fil Injeeli kazar'in akhraja shat 'ahoo fa 'aazarahoo fastaghlaza fastawaa 'alaa sooqihee yu'jibuz zurraa'a liyagheeza bihimul kuffaar; wa'adal laahul lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati minhum maghfiratanw wa ajran 'azeemaa
verses.translation: Muhammad is the messenger of Allah. And those with him are hard against the disbelievers and merciful among themselves. Thou (O Muhammad) seest them bowing and falling prostrate (in worship), seeking bounty from Allah and (His) acceptance. The mark of them is on their foreheads from the traces of prostration. Such is their likeness in the Torah and their likeness in the Gospel - like as sown corn that sendeth forth its shoot and strengtheneth it and riseth firm upon its stalk, delighting the sowers - that He may enrage the disbelievers with (the sight of) them. Allah hath promised, unto such of them as believe and do good works, forgiveness and immense reward.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Yaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanoo la tuqaddimoo baina yada yil laahi wa Rasoolihee wattaqul laah; innal laaha samee'un 'Aleem
verses.translation: O ye who believe! Be not forward in the presence of Allah and His messenger, and keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَرْفَعُوٓا۟ أَصْوَٰتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ ٱلنَّبِىِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا۟ لَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَن تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
verses.translit: Yaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanoo laa tarfa'ooo aswaatakum fawqa sawtin Nabiyi wa laa tajharoo lahoo bilqawli kajahri ba'dikum liba 'din an tahbata a 'maalukum wa antum laa tash'uroon
verses.translation: O ye who believe! Lift not up your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor shout when speaking to him as ye shout one to another, lest your works be rendered vain while ye perceive not.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَٰتَهُمْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمْتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.translit: Innal lazeena yaghud doona aswaatahum 'inda Rasoolil laahi ulaaa'ikal lazeenam tah anal laahu quloobahum littaqwaa; lahum maghfiratunw waajrun 'azeem
verses.translation: Lo! they who subdue their voices in the presence of the messenger of Allah, those are they whose hearts Allah hath proven unto righteousness. Theirs will be forgiveness and immense reward.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلْحُجُرَٰتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
verses.translit: Innal lazeena yunaadoo naka minw waraaa'il hujuraati aksaruhum laa ya'qiloon
verses.translation: Lo! those who call thee from behind the private apartments, most of them have no sense.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًۭا لَّهُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa law annahum sabaroo hatta takhruja ilaihim lakaana khairal lahum; wallaahu Ghafoorur Raheem
verses.translation: And if they had had patience till thou camest forth unto them, it had been better for them. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌۢ بِنَبَإٍۢ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ أَن تُصِيبُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٍۢ فَتُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَٰدِمِينَ
verses.translit: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanoo in jaaa'akum faasqum binaba in fatabaiyanooo an tuseeboo qawmam bijahalatin fatusbihoo 'alaa maa fa'altum naadimeen
verses.translation: O ye who believe! If an evil-liver bring you tidings, verify it, lest ye smite some folk in ignorance and afterward repent of what ye did.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِى كَثِيرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْإِيمَٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ وَٱلْفُسُوقَ وَٱلْعِصْيَانَ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّٰشِدُونَ
verses.translit: Wa'lamooo anna feekum Rasoolal laah; law yutee'ukum fee kaseerim minal amrila'anittum wa laakinnal laaha habbaba ilaikumul eemaana wa zaiyanahoo fee quloobikum wa karraha ilaikumul kufra walfusooqa wal'isyaan; ulaaaika humur raashidoon
verses.translation: And know that the messenger of Allah is among you. If he were to obey you in much of the government, ye would surely be in trouble; but Allah hath endeared the faith to you and hath beautified it in your hearts, and hath made disbelief and lewdness and rebellion hateful unto you. Such are they who are the rightly guided.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَضْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةًۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Fadlam minal laahi wa ni'mah; wallaahu 'Aleemun Hakeem
verses.translation: (It is) a bounty and a grace from Allah; and Allah is Knower, Wise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱقْتَتَلُوا۟ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَإِنۢ بَغَتْ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ فَقَٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى تَبْغِى حَتَّىٰ تَفِىٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن فَآءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ
verses.translit: Wa in taaa'ifataani minal mu'mineenaq tataloo faaslihoo bainahumaa fa-im baghat ih daahumaa 'alal ukhraa faqaatilul latee tabhee hattaa tafeee'a ilaaa amril laah; fa-in faaa't fa aslihoo bainahumaa bil'adli wa aqsitoo innal laaha yuhibbul muqsiteen
verses.translation: And if two parties of believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them. And if one party of them doeth wrong to the other, fight ye that which doeth wrong till it return unto the ordinance of Allah; then, if it return, make peace between them justly, and act equitably. Lo! Allah loveth the equitable.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌۭ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.translit: Innamal mu'minoona ikhwatun fa aslihoo baina akhawaykum wattaqul laaha la'allakum tuhamoon
verses.translation: The believers are naught else than brothers. Therefore make peace between your brethren and observe your duty to Allah that haply ye may obtain mercy.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌۭ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُوا۟ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَآءٌۭ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُنَّ ۖ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا۟ بِٱلْأَلْقَٰبِ ۖ بِئْسَ ٱلِٱسْمُ ٱلْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَتُبْ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
verses.translit: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanoo laa yaskhar qawmum min qawmin 'asaaa anyyakoonoo khairam minhum wa laa nisaaa'um min nisaaa'in 'Asaaa ay yakunna khairam minhunna wa laa talmizooo bil alqaab; bi'sal ismul fusooqu ba'dal eemaan; wa mal-lam yatub fa-ulaaa'ika humuz zaalimoon
verses.translation: O ye who believe! Let not a folk deride a folk who may be better than they (are), not let women (deride) women who may be better than they are; neither defame one another, nor insult one another by nicknames. Bad is the name of lewdness after faith. And whoso turneth not in repentance, such are evil-doers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثْمٌۭ ۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا۟ وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا ۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًۭا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanuj taniboo kaseeram minaz zanni inna ba'daz zanniismunw wa laa tajassasoo wa la yaghtab ba'dukum ba'daa; a yuhibbu ahadukum any yaakula lahma akheehi maitan fakarih tumooh; wattaqul laa; innal laaha tawwaabur Raheem
verses.translation: O ye who believe! Shun much suspicion; for lo! some suspicion is a crime. And spy not, neither backbite one another. Would one of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? Ye abhor that (so abhor the other)! And keep your duty (to Allah). Lo! Allah is Relenting, Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍۢ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَٰكُمْ شُعُوبًۭا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌۭ
verses.translit: Yaaa ayyuhan naasu innaa khalaqnaakum min zakarinw wa unsaa wa ja'alnaakum shu'oobanw wa qabaaa'ila lita'aarafoo inna akramakum 'indal laahi atqaakum innal laaha 'Aleemun khabeer
verses.translation: O mankind! Lo! We have created you male and female, and have made you nations and tribes that ye may know one another. Lo! the noblest of you, in the sight of Allah, is the best in conduct. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ قَالَتِ ٱلْأَعْرَابُ ءَامَنَّا ۖ قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَلَٰكِن قُولُوٓا۟ أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ ٱلْإِيمَٰنُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ أَعْمَٰلِكُمْ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.translit: Qaalatil-A 'raabu aamannaa qul lam tu'minoo wa laakin qoolooo aslamnaa wa lamma yadkhulil eemaanu fee quloobikum wa in tutee'ul laaha wa Rasoolahoo laa yalitkum min a'maalikum shai'aa; innal laaha Ghafoorur Raheem
verses.translation: The wandering Arabs say: We believe. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye believe not, but rather say "We submit," for the faith hath not yet entered into your hearts. Yet, if ye obey Allah and His messenger, He will not withhold from you aught of (the reward of) your deeds. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ
verses.translit: Innamal muu'minoonal lazeena aamanoo billaahi wa Rasoolihee summa lam yartaaboo wa jaahadoo biamwaalihim wa anfusihim fee sabeelil laah; ulaaaika humus saadiqoon
verses.translation: The (true) believers are those only who believe in Allah and His messenger and afterward doubt not, but strive with their wealth and their lives for the cause of Allah. Such are the sincere.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Qul atu'allimoonal laaha bideenikum wallaahu ya'lamu maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ard; wallaahu bikulli shai'in 'Aleem
verses.translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Would ye teach Allah your religion, when Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and Allah is Aware of all things?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ ۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّوا۟ عَلَىَّ إِسْلَٰمَكُم ۖ بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ هَدَىٰكُمْ لِلْإِيمَٰنِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.translit: Yamunnoona 'alaika an aslamoo qul laa tamunnoo 'alaiya Islaamakum balillaahu yamunnu 'alaikum an hadaakum lil eemaani in kuntum saadiqeen
verses.translation: They make it a favour unto thee (Muhammad) that they have surrendered (unto Him). Say: Deem not your Surrender a favour unto me; but Allah doth confer a favour on you, inasmuch as He hath led you to the Faith, if ye are earnest.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translit: Innal laaha ya'lamu ghaibas samaawaati wal ard; wallaahu baseerum bimaa ta'maloon
verses.translation: Lo! Allah knoweth the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
verses.translit: Qaaaf; wal Qur aanil Majeed
verses.translation: Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
verses.translit: Bal 'ajibooo an jaa'ahum munzirum minhum faqaalal kaafiroona haazaa shai'un 'ajeeb
verses.translation: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing:
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ
verses.translit: 'A-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaaban zaalika raj'um ba'eed
verses.translation: When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
verses.translit: Qad 'alimnaa maa tanqu-sul-ardu minhum wa 'indanaa Kitaabun Hafeez
verses.translation: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍۢ مَّرِيجٍ
verses.translit: Bal kazzaboo bilhaqqi lammaa jaaa'ahum fahum feee amrim mareej
verses.translation: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍۢ
verses.translit: Afalam yanzurooo ilas samaaa'i fawqahum kaifa banainaahaa wa zaiyannaahaa wa maa lahaa min furooj
verses.translation: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ
verses.translit: Wal arda madadnaahaa wa alqainaa feehaa rawaasiya wa ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjim baheej
verses.translation: And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: تَبْصِرَةًۭ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍۢ مُّنِيبٍۢ
verses.translit: Tabsiratanw wa zikraa likulli 'abdim muneeb
verses.translation: A vision and a reminder for every penitent slave.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ مُّبَٰرَكًۭا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
verses.translit: Wa nazzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'am mubaarakan fa ambatnaa bihee jannaatinw wa habbal haseed
verses.translation: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍۢ لَّهَا طَلْعٌۭ نَّضِيدٌۭ
verses.translit: Wannakhla baasiqaatil laha tal'un nadeed
verses.translation: And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: رِّزْقًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
verses.translit: Rizqal lil'ibaad, wa ahyainaa bihee baldatam maitaa; kazaalikal khurooj
verses.translation: Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
verses.translit: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohinw wa Ashaabur Rassi wa Samood
verses.translation: The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa 'Aadunw wa Fir'awnu wikhwaanu loot
verses.translation: And (the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verses.translit: Wa Ashaabul Aykati wa qawmu Tubba'; kullun kazzabar Rusula fahaqqa wa'eed
verses.translation: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍۢ مِّنْ خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ
verses.translit: Afa'a yeenaa bilkhalqil awwal; bal hum fee labsim min khalqin jadeed
verses.translation: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
verses.translit: Wa laqad khalaqnal insaana wa na'lamu maa tuwaswisu bihee nafsuhoo wa Nahnu aqrabu ilaihi min hablil wareed
verses.translation: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌۭ
verses.translit: 'Iz yatalaqqal mutalaqqi yaani 'anil yameeni wa 'anish shimaali qa'eed
verses.translation: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌۭ
verses.translit: Maa yalfizu min qawlin illaa ladaihi raqeebun 'ateed
verses.translation: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
verses.translit: Wajaat sakratu almawti bialhaqqi thalika ma kunta minhu taheedu
verses.translation: And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.translit: Wa nufikha fis Soor; zaalika yawmul wa'eed
verses.translation: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌۭ وَشَهِيدٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa jaaa'at kullu nafsim ma'ahaa saaa'iqunw wa shaheed
verses.translation: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ
verses.translit: Laqad kunta fee ghaf latim min haazaa fakashafnaa 'anka ghitaaa'aka fabasarukal yawma hadeed
verses.translation: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
verses.translit: Wa qaala qareenuhoo haazaa maa ladaiya 'ateed
verses.translation: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ
verses.translit: Alqiyaa fee Jahannama kulla kaffaarin 'aneed
verses.translation: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍۢ مُّرِيبٍ
verses.translit: Mannaa'il lilkhayri mu'tadim mureeb
verses.translation: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
verses.translit: Allazee ja'ala ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fa alqiyaahu fil'azaabish shadeed
verses.translation: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
verses.translit: Qaala qareenuhoo Rabbanaa maaa atghaituhoo wa laakin kaana fee dalaahim ba'eed
verses.translation: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.translit: Qaala laa takhtasimoo ladaayya wa qad qaddamtu ilaikum bilwa'eed
verses.translation: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verses.translit: Maa yubaddalul qawlu ladaiya wa maaa ana bizal laamil lil'abeed
verses.translation: The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍۢ
verses.translit: Yawma naqoolu li'jahannama halim talaati wa taqoolu hal mim mazeed
verses.translation: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
verses.translit: Wa uzlifatil jannatu lil muttaqeena ghaira ba'eed
verses.translation: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍۢ
verses.translit: Haaza maa too'adoona likulli awwaabin hafeez
verses.translation: (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍۢ مُّنِيبٍ
verses.translit: Man khashiyar Rahmaana bilghaibi wa jaaa'a biqalbim muneeb
verses.translation: Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍۢ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
verses.translit: Udkhuloohaa bisalaamin zaalika yawmul khulood
verses.translation: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ
verses.translit: Lahum maa yashaaa'oona feehaa wa ladainaa mazeed
verses.translation: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
verses.translit: Wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fil bilaad, hal mim mahees
verses.translation: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌۭ
verses.translit: Inna fee zaalika lazikraa liman kaana lahoo qalbun aw alqas sam'a wa huwa shaheed
verses.translation: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa laqad khalaqnas samaawaati wal arda wa maa bainahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin wa maa massanaa mil lughoob
verses.translation: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
verses.translit: Fasbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wa sabbih bihamdi Rabbika qabla tuloo'ish shamsi wa qablal ghuroob
verses.translation: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
verses.translit: Wa minal laili fasabbih hu wa adbaaras sujood
verses.translation: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ
verses.translit: Wastami' yawma yunaa dil munaadi mim makaanin qareeb
verses.translation: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
verses.translit: Yawma yasmaoonas sai hata bilhaqq zaalika yawmul khurooj
verses.translation: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.translit: Innaa Nahnu nuhyee wa numeetu wa ilainal maseer
verses.translation: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌۭ
verses.translit: Yawma tashaqqaqul ardu 'anhum siraa'aa; zaalika hashrun 'alainaa yaseer
verses.translation: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍۢ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
verses.translit: Nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona wa maaa anta 'alihim bijabbaarin fazakkir bil quraani many yakhaafu wa'eed
verses.translation: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًۭا
verses.translit: Waz-zaariyaati zarwaa
verses.translation: By those that winnow with a winnowing
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًۭا
verses.translit: Falhaamilaati wiqraa
verses.translation: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًۭا
verses.translit: Faljaariyaati yusraa
verses.translation: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا
verses.translit: Falmuqassimaati amraa
verses.translation: And those who distribute (blessings) by command,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌۭ
verses.translit: Innamaa too'adoona la-saadiq
verses.translation: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa innad deena la waaqi'
verses.translation: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
verses.translit: Wassamaaa'i zaatil hubuk
verses.translation: By the heaven full of paths,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفٍۢ
verses.translit: Innakum lafee qawlim mukhtalif
verses.translation: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
verses.translit: Yu'faku 'anhu man ufik
verses.translation: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
verses.translit: Qutilal kharraasoon
verses.translation: Accursed be the conjecturers
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ سَاهُونَ
verses.translit: Allazeena hum fee ghamratin saahoon
verses.translation: Who are careless in an abyss!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.translit: Yas'aloona ayyaana yawmud Deen
verses.translation: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
verses.translit: Yawma hum 'alan naari yuftanoon
verses.translation: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.translit: Zooqoo fitnatakum haa zal lazee kuntum bihee tas ta'jiloon
verses.translation: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.translit: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon
verses.translation: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
verses.translit: Aakhizeena maaa aataahum Rabbuhum; innahum kaanoo qabla zaalika muhsineen
verses.translation: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
verses.translit: kaanoo qaleelam minal laili maa yahja'oon
verses.translation: They used to sleep but little of the night,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa bilashaari hum yastaghfiroon
verses.translation: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verses.translit: Wa feee amwaalihim haqqul lissaaa'ili walmahroom
verses.translation: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
verses.translit: Wa fil ardi aayaatul lilmooqineen
verses.translation: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa feee anfusikum; afalaa tubsiroon
verses.translation: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.translit: Wa fissamaaa'i rizqukum wa maa too'adoon
verses.translation: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
verses.translit: Fawa Rabbis samaaa'i wal ardi innahoo lahaqqum misla maa annakum tantiqoon
verses.translation: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.translit: Hal ataaka hadeesu daifi Ibraaheemal mukrameen
verses.translation: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.translit: Iz dakhaloo 'alaihi faqaaloo salaaman qaala salaamun qawmum munkaroon
verses.translation: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍۢ سَمِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Faraagha ilaaa ahlihee fajaaa'a bi'ijlin sameen
verses.translation: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.translit: Faqarrabahooo ilaihim qaala alaa taakuloon
verses.translation: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Fa awjasa minhm khee fatan qaaloo laa takhaf wa bashsharoohu bighulaamin 'aleem
verses.translation: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍۢ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Fa aqbalatim ra-atuhoo fee sarratin fasakkat wajhahaa wa qaalat 'ajoozun 'aqeem
verses.translation: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.translit: Qaaloo kazaaliki qaala Rabbuki innahoo huwal hakeemul 'aleem
verses.translation: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.translit: Qaala famaa khatbukum ayyuhal mursaloon
verses.translation: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.translit: Qaalooo innaaa ursilnaaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen
verses.translation: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن طِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Linursila 'alaihim hijaa ratam min teen
verses.translation: That we may send upon them stones of clay,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.translit: Musawwamatan 'inda rabbika lilmusrifeen
verses.translation: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Fa akhrajnaa man kaana feehaa minal mu'mineen
verses.translation: Then we brought forth such believers as were there.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.translit: Famaa wajadnaa feehaa ghaira baitim minal muslimeen
verses.translation: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.translit: Wa taraknaa feehaaa aayatal lillazeena yakhaafoonal 'azaabal aleem
verses.translation: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa fee Moosaaa iz arsalnaahu ilaa Fir'wna bisultaa nim mubeen
verses.translation: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌۭ
verses.translit: Fatawalla biruknihee wa qaala saahirun aw majnoon
verses.translation: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Fa akhaznaahu wa junoo dahoo fanabaznaahum fil yammi wa huwa muleem
verses.translation: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
verses.translit: Wa fee 'Aadin iz arsalnaa 'alaihimur reehal'aqeem
verses.translation: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
verses.translit: Maa tazaru min shai'in atat 'alaihi illaa ja'alat hu karrameem
verses.translation: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa fee Samooda iz qeela lahum tamatta''oo hattaa heen
verses.translation: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.translit: Fa'ataw 'an amri Rabbihim fa akhazal humus saa'iqatu wa hum yanzuroon
verses.translation: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.translit: Famas tataa'oo min qiyaaminw wa maa kaanoo muntasireen
verses.translation: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
verses.translit: Wa qawma Noohim min qablu innahum kaano qawman faasiqeen
verses.translation: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
verses.translit: Wassamaaa'a banainaa haa bi aydinw wa innaa lamoosi'oon
verses.translation: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ
verses.translit: Wal arda farashnaahaa fani'mal maahidoon
verses.translation: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa min kulli shai'in khalaqnaa zawjaini la'allakum tazakkaroon
verses.translation: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Fafirrooo ilal laahi innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen
verses.translation: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa laa taj'aloo ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen
verses.translation: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.translit: Kazaalika maaa atal lazeena min qablihim mir Rasoolin illaa qaaloo saahirun aw majnoon
verses.translation: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
verses.translit: Atawaasaw bih; bal hum qawmun taaghoon
verses.translation: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍۢ
verses.translit: Fatawalla 'anhum famaaa anta bimaloom
verses.translation: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Wa zakkir fa innaz zikraa tanfa'ul mu'mineen
verses.translation: And warn, for warning profiteth believers.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
verses.translit: Wa maa khalaqtul jinna wal insa illaa liya'budoon
verses.translation: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
verses.translit: Maaa ureedu minhum mir rizqinw wa maaa ureedu anyyut'imoon
verses.translation: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
verses.translit: Innal laaha Huwar Razzaaqu Zul Quwwatil Mateen
verses.translation: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًۭا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
verses.translit: Fa inna lillazeena zalamoo zanoobam misla zanoobi ashaabihim falaa yasta'jiloon
verses.translation: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.translit: Fawailul lillazeena kafaroo miny yawmihimul lazee yoo'adoon
verses.translation: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلطُّورِ
verses.translit: Wat-Toor
verses.translation: By the Mount,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَكِتَٰبٍۢ مَّسْطُورٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa kitaabim mastoor
verses.translation: And a Scripture inscribed
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فِى رَقٍّۢ مَّنشُورٍۢ
verses.translit: Fee raqqim manshoor
verses.translation: On fine parchment unrolled,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
verses.translit: Wal baitil ma'moor
verses.translation: And the House frequented,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
verses.translit: Wassaqfil marfoo'
verses.translation: And the roof exalted,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
verses.translit: Wal bahril masjoor
verses.translation: And the sea kept filled,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
verses.translit: Inna 'azaaba Rabbika lawaaqi'
verses.translation: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍۢ
verses.translit: Maa lahoo min daafi'
verses.translation: There is none that can ward it off.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًۭا
verses.translit: Yawma tamoorus samaaa'u mawraa
verses.translation: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًۭا
verses.translit: Wa taseerul jibaalu sairaa
verses.translation: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَوَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.translit: Fawailuny yawma 'izil lil mukaazzibeen
verses.translation: Then woe that day unto the deniers
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.translit: Allazeena hum fee khawdiny yal'aboon
verses.translation: Who play in talk of grave matters;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
verses.translit: Yawma yuda'-'oona ilaa naari jahannama da'-'aa
verses.translation: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translit: Haazihin naarul latee kuntum bihaa tukazziboon
verses.translation: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.translit: Afasihrun haazaaaa am antum laa tubsiroon
verses.translation: Is this magic, or do ye not see?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translit: Islawhaa fasbirooo aw laa tasbiroo sawaaa'un 'alaikum innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon
verses.translation: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَعِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa na'eem
verses.translation: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.translit: Faakiheena bimaaa aataahum rabbuhum wa waqaahum rabbuhum 'azaabal jaheem
verses.translation: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translit: Kuloo washraboo haneee 'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
verses.translation: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Muttaki'eena 'alaa sururim masfoofatinw wa zawwaj naahum bihoorin 'een
verses.translation: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Wallazeena aamanoo wattaba'at hum zurriyyatuhum bieemaanin alhaqnaa bihim zurriyyatahum wa maaa alatnaahum min 'amalihim min shai'; kullum ri'im bimaa kasaba raheen
verses.translation: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ وَلَحْمٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.translit: Wa amdadnaahum bifaa kihatinw wa lahmim mimmaa yashtahoon
verses.translation: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Yatanaaza'oona feehaa kaasal laa laghwun feehaa wa laa taaseem
verses.translation: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa yatoofu 'alaihim ghilmaanul lahum ka annahum lu'lu'um maknoon
verses.translation: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.translit: Wa aqbala ba'duhum 'alaa ba'diny yatasaaa'aloon
verses.translation: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
verses.translit: Qaalooo innaa kunnaa qablu feee ahlinaa mushfiqeen
verses.translation: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.translit: Famannnal laahu 'alainaa wa waqaanaa 'azaabas samoom
verses.translation: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.translit: Innaa kunnaa min qablu nad'oohu innahoo huwal barrur raheem
verses.translation: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
verses.translit: Fazakkir famaaa anta bini'mati rabbika bikaahininw wa laa majnoon
verses.translation: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
verses.translit: Am yaqooloona shaa'irun natarabbasu bihee raibal manoon
verses.translation: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
verses.translit: Qul tarabbasoo fa innee ma'akum minal mutarabbiseen
verses.translation: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
verses.translit: Am taamuruhum ahlaamuhum bihaazaaa am hum qawmun taaghoon
verses.translation: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.translit: Am yaqooloona taqawwalah; bal laa yu'minoon
verses.translation: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.translit: Falyaatoo bihadeesim misliheee in kaanoo saadiqeen
verses.translation: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
verses.translit: Am khuliqoo min ghairi shai'in am humul khaaliqoon
verses.translation: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.translit: Am khalaqus samaawaati wal ard; bal laa yooqinoon
verses.translation: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
verses.translit: Am'indahum khazaaa'inu rabbika am humul musaitiroon
verses.translation: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.translit: Am lahum sullamuny yastami'oona feehi falyaati mustami'uhum bisultaanim mubeen
verses.translation: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verses.translit: Am lahul banaatu wa lakumul banoon
verses.translation: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verses.translit: Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim musqaloon
verses.translation: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verses.translit: Am 'indahumul ghaibu fahum yaktuboon
verses.translation: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
verses.translit: Am yureedoona kaidan fallazeena kafaroo humul makeedoon
verses.translation: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.translit: Am lahum ilaahun ghairul laa; subhaanal laahi 'ammaa yushrikoon
verses.translation: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa iny yaraw kisfam minas samaaa'i saaqitany yaqooloo sahaabum markoom
verses.translation: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
verses.translit: Fazarhum hatta yulaaqoo yawmahumul lazee feehi yus'aqoon
verses.translation: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.translit: Yawma laa yughnee 'anhum kaidumhum shai'anw wa laa hum yunsaroon
verses.translation: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translit: Wa inna lillazeena zalamoo 'azaaban doona zalika wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon
verses.translation: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verses.translit: Wasbir lihukmi rabbika fa innaka bi-a'yuninaa wa sabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoom
verses.translation: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.translit: Wa minal laili fasabbihhu wa idbaaran nujoom
verses.translation: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
verses.translit: Wannajmi izaa hawaa
verses.translation: By the Star when it setteth,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
verses.translit: Maa dalla saahibukum wa maa ghawaa
verses.translation: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Wa maa yyantiqu 'anilhawaaa
verses.translation: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌۭ يُوحَىٰ
verses.translit: In huwa illaa Wahyuny yoohaa
verses.translation: It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
verses.translit: 'Allamahoo shadeedul quwaa
verses.translation: Which one of mighty powers hath taught him,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ذُو مِرَّةٍۢ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
verses.translit: Zoo mirratin fastawaa
verses.translation: One vigorous; and he grew clear to view
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa huwa bil ufuqil a'laa
verses.translation: When he was on the uppermost horizon.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
verses.translit: Summa danaa fatadalla
verses.translation: Then he drew nigh and came down
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
verses.translit: Fakaana qaaba qawsaini aw adnaa
verses.translation: Till he was (distant) two bows' length or even nearer,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
verses.translit: Fa awhaaa ilaa 'abdihee maaa awhaa
verses.translation: And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Maa kazabal fu'aadu maa ra aa
verses.translation: The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
verses.translit: Afatumaaroonahoo 'alaa maayaraa
verses.translation: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa laqad ra aahu nazlatan ukhraa
verses.translation: And verily he saw him yet another time
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
verses.translit: 'Inda sidratil muntaha
verses.translation: By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
verses.translit: 'Indahaa jannatul maawaa
verses.translation: Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode.
