verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
verses.translit: Iz yaghshas sidrata maa yaghshaa
verses.translation: When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
verses.translit: Maa zaaghal basaru wa maa taghaa
verses.translation: The eye turned not aside nor yet was overbold.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Laqad ra aa min aayaati Rabbihil kubraaa
verses.translation: Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
verses.translit: Afara'aytumul laata wal 'uzzaa
verses.translation: Have ye thought upon Al-Lat and Al-'Uzza
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Wa manaatas saalisatal ukhraa
verses.translation: And Manat, the third, the other?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
verses.translit: A-lakumuz zakaru wa lahul unsaa
verses.translation: Are yours the males and His the females?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: تِلْكَ إِذًۭا قِسْمَةٌۭ ضِيزَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Tilka izan qismatun deezaa
verses.translation: That indeed were an unfair division!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌۭ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
verses.translit: In hiya illaaa asmaaa'un sammaitumoohaaa antum wa aabaaa'ukum maaa anzalal laahu bihaa min sultaan; inyyattabi'oona illaz zanna wa maa tahwal anfusu wa laqad jaaa'ahum mir Rabbihimul hudaa
verses.translation: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
verses.translit: Am lil insaani maa taman naa
verses.translation: Or shall man have what he coveteth?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.translit: Falillaahil aakhiratu wal oolaa
verses.translation: But unto Allah belongeth the after (life), and the former.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Wa kam mim malakin fissamaawaati laa tughnee shafaa'atuhum shai'an illaa mim ba'di anyyaazanal laahu limany yashaaa'u wa yardaa
verses.translation: And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
verses.translit: innal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil aakhirati la yusammoonal malaaa'ikata tasmiyatal unsaa
verses.translation: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًۭٔا
verses.translit: Wa maa lahum bihee min 'ilmin iny yattabi'oona illaz zanna wa innaz zanna laa yughnee minal haqqi shai'aa
verses.translation: And they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and lo! a guess can never take the place of the truth.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
verses.translit: Fa a'rid 'am man tawallaa 'an zikrinaa wa lam yurid illal hayaatad dunyaa
verses.translation: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.translit: Zalika mablaghuhum minal 'ilm; inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu biman dalla 'an sabee lihee wa huwa a'lamu bimanih tadaa
verses.translation: Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
verses.translit: Wa lillaahi maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi liyajziyal lazeena asaaa'oo bimaa 'amiloo wa yajziyal lazeena ahsanoo bilhusnaa
verses.translation: And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌۭ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Allazeena yajtaniboona kabaaa'iral ismi walfawaa hisha illal lamam; inna rabbaka waasi'ul maghfirah; huwa a'lamu bikum iz ansha akum minal ardi wa iz antum ajinnatun fee butooni umma haatikum falaa tuzakkooo anfusakum huwa a'lamu bimanit taqaa
verses.translation: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
verses.translit: Afara'ayatal lazee tawallaa
verses.translation: Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًۭا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Wa a'taa qaleelanw wa akdaa
verses.translation: And gave a little, then was grudging?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
verses.translit: A'indahoo 'ilmul ghaibi fahuwa yaraa
verses.translation: Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
verses.translit: Am lam yunabbaa bimaa fee suhuhfi Moosa
verses.translation: Or hath he not had news of what is in the books of Moses
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
verses.translit: Wa Ibraaheemal lazee waffaaa
verses.translation: And Abraham who paid his debt:
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
verses.translit: Allaa taziru waaziratunw wizra ukhraa
verses.translation: That no laden one shall bear another's load,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa al laisa lil insaani illaa maa sa'aa
verses.translation: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa anna sa'yahoo sawfa yuraa
verses.translation: And that his effort will be seen.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
verses.translit: Summa yujzaahul jazaaa 'al awfaa
verses.translation: And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa anna ilaa rabbikal muntahaa
verses.translation: And that thy Lord, He is the goal;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa annahoo huwa adhaka wa abkaa
verses.translation: And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
verses.translit: Wa annahoo huwa amaata wa ahyaa
verses.translation: And that He it is Who giveth death and giveth life;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa annahoo khalaqaz zawjainiz zakara wal unsaa
verses.translation: And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
verses.translit: Min nutfatin izaa tumnaa
verses.translation: From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa anna 'alaihin nash atal ukhraa
verses.translation: And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa annahoo huwa aghnaa wa aqnaa
verses.translation: And that He it is Who enricheth and contenteth;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa annahoo huwa rabbush shi'raa
verses.translation: And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa annahooo ahlak a 'Aadanil oolaa
verses.translation: And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) A'ad,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa samooda famaaa abqaa
verses.translation: And (the tribe of) Thamud He spared not;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
verses.translit: Wa qawma Noohim min qablu innahum kaanoo hum azlama wa atghaa
verses.translation: And the folk of Noah aforetime, Lo! they were more unjust and more rebellious;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
verses.translit: Wal mu'tafikata ahwaa
verses.translation: And Al-Mu'tafikah He destroyed
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
verses.translit: Faghashshaahaa maa ghashshaa
verses.translation: So that there covered them that which did cover.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbika tatamaaraa
verses.translation: Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَٰذَا نَذِيرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
verses.translit: Haazaa nazeerum minan nuzuril oolaa
verses.translation: This is a warner of the warners of old.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْءَازِفَةُ
verses.translit: Azifatil laazifah
verses.translation: The threatened Hour is nigh.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
verses.translit: Laisa lahaa min doonil laahi kaashifah
verses.translation: None beside Allah can disclose it.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَمِنْ هَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
verses.translit: Afamin hazal hadeesi ta'jaboon
verses.translation: Marvel ye then at this statement,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
verses.translit: Wa tadhakoona wa laa tabkoon
verses.translation: And laugh and not weep,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنتُمْ سَٰمِدُونَ
verses.translit: Wa antum saamidoon
verses.translation: While ye amuse yourselves?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
verses.translit: Fasjudoo lillaahi wa'budoo
verses.translation: Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
verses.translit: Iqtarabatis Saa'atu wsan shaqqal qamar
verses.translation: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ
verses.translit: Wa iny yaraw aayatany yu'ridoo wa yaqooloo sihrum mustamirr
verses.translation: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
verses.translit: Wa kazzaboo wattaba'ooo ahwaaa'ahum; wa kullu amrim mustaqirr
verses.translation: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
verses.translit: Wa laqad jaaa'ahum minal ambaaa'i maa feehi muzdajar
verses.translation: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.translit: Hikmatum baalighatun famaa tughnin nuzur
verses.translation: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ
verses.translit: Fatawalla 'anhum; yawma yad'ud daa'i ilaa shai 'in nukur
verses.translation: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ
verses.translit: khushsha'an absaaruhum yakrujoona minal ajdaasi ka annahum jaraadum muntashir
verses.translation: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ
verses.translit: Muhti'eena ilad daa'i yaqoolul kafiroona haazaa yawmun 'asir
verses.translation: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
verses.translit: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohin fakazzaboo 'abdanaa wa qaaloo majnoo nunw wazdujir
verses.translation: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ
verses.translit: Fada'aa Rabbahooo annee maghloobun fantasir
verses.translation: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ
verses.translit: Fafatahnaaa abwaabas sa maaa'i bimaa'im munhamir
verses.translation: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ
verses.translit: Wa fajjamal arda 'uyoonan faltaqal maaa'u 'alaaa amrin qad qudir
verses.translation: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa hamalnaahu 'alaa zaati alwaahinw wa dusur
verses.translation: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
verses.translit: Tajree bi a'yuninaa jazaaa 'al liman kaana kufir
verses.translation: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa laqat taraknaahaad aayatan fahal mim muddakir
verses.translation: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translit: Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur
verses.translation: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa laqad yassamal Quraana liz zikri fahal mimmuddakir
verses.translation: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translit: Kazzabat 'Aadun fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur
verses.translation: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ
verses.translit: Innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim reehan sarsaran fee Yawmi nahsim mustamirr
verses.translation: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ
verses.translit: Tanzi;un naasa ka anna huma'jaazu nakhlim munqa'ir
verses.translation: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translit: 'Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur
verses.translation: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa laqad yassamal Quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir
verses.translation: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translit: Kazzabat Samoodu binnuzur
verses.translation: (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.translit: Faqaalooo a-basharam minnaa waahidan nattabi'uhooo innaa izal lafee dalaalinw wa su'ur
verses.translation: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ
verses.translit: 'A-ulqiyaz zikru 'alaihi mim baininaa bal huwa kazzaabun ashir
verses.translation: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
verses.translit: Sa-ya'lamoona ghadam manil kazzaabul ashir
verses.translation: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
verses.translit: Innaa mursilun naaqati fitnatal lahum fartaqibhum wastabir
verses.translation: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa nabbi'hum annal maaa'a qismatum bainahum kullu shirbim muhtadar
verses.translation: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
verses.translit: Fanaadaw saahibahum fata'aataa fa'aqar
verses.translation: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translit: Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur
verses.translation: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verses.translit: Innaaa arsalnaa 'alaihim saihatanw waahidatan fakaano kahasheemil muhtazir
verses.translation: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa laqad yassarnal quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir
verses.translation: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translit: Kazzabat qawmu lootim binnuzur
verses.translation: The folk of Lot rejected warnings.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ
verses.translit: Innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim haasiban illaaa aala Loot najjainaahum bisahar
verses.translation: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
verses.translit: Ni'matam min 'indinaa; kazaalika najzee man shakar
verses.translation: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translit: Wa laqad anzarahum batshatanaa fatamaaraw binnuzur
verses.translation: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translit: Wa laqad raawadoohu 'andaifee fatamasnaaa a'yunahum fazooqoo 'azaabee wa nuzur
verses.translation: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
verses.translit: Wa laqad sabbahahum bukratan 'azaabum mustaqirr
verses.translation: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translit: Fazooqoo 'azaabee wa nuzur
verses.translation: Now taste My punishment after My warnings!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa laqad yassarnal Quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir
verses.translation: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.translit: Wa laqad jaaa'a Aala Fir'awnan nuzur
verses.translation: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
verses.translit: Kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa kullihaa fa akhaznaahum akhza 'azeezim muqtadir
verses.translation: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.translit: Akuffaarukum khairum min ulaaa'ikum am lakum baraaa'atun fiz Zubur
verses.translation: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ
verses.translit: Am yaqooloona nahnu jamee'um muntasir
verses.translation: Or say they: We are a host victorious?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verses.translit: Sa yuhzamul jam'u wa yuwalloonad dubur
verses.translation: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verses.translit: Balis Saa'atu maw'iduhum was Saa'atu adhaa wa amarr
verses.translation: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ
verses.translit: Innal mujrimeena fee dalaalinw wa su'ur
verses.translation: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.translit: Yawma yushaboona fin Naari'alaa wujoohimim zooqoo massa saqar
verses.translation: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ
verses.translit: Innaa kulla shai'in khalaqnaahu biqadar
verses.translation: Lo! We have created every thing by measure.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
verses.translit: Wa maaa amrunaaa illaa waahidatun kalamhim bilbasar
verses.translation: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa laqad ahlaknaaa ashyaa'akum fahal mim muddakir
verses.translation: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.translit: Wa kullu shai'in fa'aloohu fiz Zubur
verses.translation: And every thing they did is in the scriptures,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
verses.translit: Wa kullu sagheerinw wa kabeerim mustatar
verses.translation: And every small and great thing is recorded.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ
verses.translit: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa nahar
verses.translation: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
verses.translit: Fee maq'adi sidqin 'inda Maleekim Muqtadir
verses.translation: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ
verses.translit: Ar Rahmaan
verses.translation: The Beneficent
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
verses.translit: 'Allamal Quran
verses.translation: Hath made known the Qur'an.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ
verses.translit: Khalaqal insaan
verses.translation: He hath created man.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
verses.translit: 'Allamalhul bayaan
verses.translation: He hath taught him utterance.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍۢ
verses.translit: Ashshamsu walqamaru bihusbaan
verses.translation: The sun and the moon are made punctual.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
verses.translit: Wannajmu washshajaru yasjudan
verses.translation: The stars and the trees prostrate.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
verses.translit: Wassamaaa'a rafa'ahaa wa wada'al Meezan
verses.translation: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
verses.translit: Allaa tatghaw fil meezaan
verses.translation: That ye exceed not the measure,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
verses.translit: Wa aqeemul wazna bilqisti wa laa tukhsirul meezaan
verses.translation: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
verses.translit: Wal arda wada'ahaa lilanaame
verses.translation: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
verses.translit: Feehaa faakihatunw wan nakhlu zaatul akmaam
verses.translation: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
verses.translit: Walhabbu zul 'asfi war Raihaanu
verses.translation: Husked grain and scented herb.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
verses.translit: Khalaqal insaana min salsaalin kalfakhkhaari
verses.translation: He created man of clay like the potter's,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍۢ مِّن نَّارٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa khalaqal jaaan mim maarijim min naar
verses.translation: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
verses.translit: Rabbul mashriqayni wa Rabbul maghribayni
verses.translation: Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
verses.translit: Marajal bahrayni yalta qiyaani
verses.translation: He hath loosed the two seas. They meet.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌۭ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
verses.translit: Bainahumaa barzakhul laa yabghiyaan
verses.translation: There is a barrier between them. They encroach not (one upon the other).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
verses.translit: Yakhruju minhumal lu 'lu u wal marjaanu
verses.translation: There cometh forth from both of them the pearl and coral-stone.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ
verses.translit: Wa lahul jawaaril mun sha'aatu fil bahri kal a'laam
verses.translation: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍۢ
verses.translit: Kullu man 'alaihaa faan
verses.translation: Everyone that is thereon will pass away;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
verses.translit: Wa yabqaa wajhu rabbika zul jalaali wal ikraam
verses.translation: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ
verses.translit: Yas'aluhoo man fissamaawaati walard; kulla ywmin huwa fee shaan
verses.translation: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
verses.translit: Sanafrughu lakum ayyuhas saqalaan
verses.translation: We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn).
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ
verses.translit: Yaa ma'sharal jinni wal insi inis tata'tum an tanfuzoo min aqtaaris samaawaati wal ardi fanfuzoo; laa tanfuzoona illaa bisultaan
verses.translation: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ وَنُحَاسٌۭ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
verses.translit: Yursalu 'alaikumaa shuwaazum min naarifiw-wa nuhaasun falaa tantasiraan
verses.translation: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
verses.translit: Fa-izan shaqqatis samaaa'u fakaanat wardatan kaddihaan
verses.translation: And when the heaven splitteth asunder and becometh rosy like red hide -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
verses.translit: Fa-yawma'izil laa yus'alu 'an zambiheee insunw wa laa jaann
verses.translation: On that day neither man nor jinni will be questioned of his sin.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
verses.translit: Yu'raful mujrimoona biseemaahum fa'yu'khazu binna waasi wal aqdaam
verses.translation: The guilty will be known by their marks, and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.translit: Haazihee jahannamul latee yukazzibu bihal mujrimoon
verses.translation: This is hell which the guilty deny.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٍۢ
verses.translit: Yatoofoona bainahaa wa baina hameemim aan
verses.translation: They go circling round between it and fierce, boiling water.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ
verses.translit: Wa liman khaafa maqaama rabbihee jannataan
verses.translation: But for him who feareth the standing before his Lord there are two gardens.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ذَوَاتَآ أَفْنَانٍۢ
verses.translit: Zawaataaa afnaan
verses.translation: Of spreading branches.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ
verses.translit: Feehimaa 'aynaani tajriyaan
verses.translation: Wherein are two fountains flowing.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍۢ زَوْجَانِ
verses.translit: Feehimaa min kulli faakihatin zawjaan
verses.translation: Wherein is every kind of fruit in pairs.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍۢ
verses.translit: Muttaki'eena 'alaa furushim bataaa'inuhaa min istabraq; wajanal jannataini daan
verses.translation: Reclining upon couches lined with silk brocade, the fruit of both the gardens near to hand.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
verses.translit: Feehinna qaasiratut tarfi lam yatmishunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann
verses.translation: Therein are those of modest gaze, whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلْيَاقُوتُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
verses.translit: ka annahunnal yaaqootu wal marjaan
verses.translation: (In beauty) like the jacynth and the coral-stone.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَلْ جَزَآءُ ٱلْإِحْسَٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلْإِحْسَٰنُ
verses.translit: Hal jazaaa'ul ihsaani illal ihsaan
verses.translation: Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ
verses.translit: Wa min doonihimaa jannataan
verses.translation: And beside them are two other gardens,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مُدْهَآمَّتَانِ
verses.translit: Mudhaaammataan
verses.translation: Dark green with foliage.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ
verses.translit: Feehimaa 'aynaani nad daakhataan
verses.translation: Wherein are two abundant springs.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فِيهِمَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَنَخْلٌۭ وَرُمَّانٌۭ
verses.translit: Feehimaa faakihatunw wa nakhlunw wa rummaan
verses.translation: Wherein is fruit, the date-palm and pomegranate.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَٰتٌ حِسَانٌۭ
verses.translit: Feehinna khairaatun hisaan
verses.translation: Wherein (are found) the good and beautiful -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: حُورٌۭ مَّقْصُورَٰتٌۭ فِى ٱلْخِيَامِ
verses.translit: Hoorum maqsooraatun fil khiyaam
verses.translation: Fair ones, close-guarded in pavilions -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
verses.translit: Lam yatmis hunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann
verses.translation: Whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍۢ
verses.translit: Muttaki'eena 'alaa rafratin khudrinw wa 'abqariyyin hisaan
verses.translation: Reclining on green cushions and fair carpets.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.translit: Fabi ayyi aalaaa'i Rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.
verses.translation: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
verses.translit: Tabaarakasmu Rabbika Zil-Jalaali wal-Ikraam
verses.translation: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, Mighty and glorious!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
verses.translit: Izaa waqa'atil waaqi'ah
verses.translation: When the event befalleth -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
verses.translit: Laisa liwaq'atihaa kaazibah
verses.translation: There is no denying that it will befall -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: خَافِضَةٌۭ رَّافِعَةٌ
verses.translit: Khafidatur raafi'ah
verses.translation: Abasing (some), exalting (others);
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّۭا
verses.translit: Izaa rujjatil ardu rajjaa
verses.translation: When the earth is shaken with a shock
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّۭا
verses.translit: Wa bussatil jibaalu bassaa
verses.translation: And the hills are ground to powder
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءًۭ مُّنۢبَثًّۭا
verses.translit: Fakaanat habaaa'am mumbassaa
verses.translation: So that they become a scattered dust,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ثَلَٰثَةًۭ
verses.translit: Wa kuntum azwaajan salaasah
verses.translation: And ye will be three kinds:
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
verses.translit: Fa as haabul maimanati maaa as haabul maimanah
verses.translation: (First) those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
verses.translit: Wa as haabul mash'amati maaa as haabul mash'amah
verses.translation: And (then) those on the left hand; what of those on the left hand?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ
verses.translit: Wassaabiqoonas saabiqoon
verses.translation: And the foremost in the race, the foremost in the race:
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
verses.translit: Ulaaa'ikal muqarraboon
verses.translation: Those are they who will be brought nigh
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.translit: Fee Jannaatin Na'eem
verses.translation: In gardens of delight;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translit: Sullatum minal awwaleen
verses.translation: A multitude of those of old
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَقَلِيلٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verses.translit: Wa qaleelum minal aa khireen
verses.translation: And a few of those of later time.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّوْضُونَةٍۢ
verses.translit: 'Alaa sururim mawdoonah
verses.translation: On lined couches,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ
verses.translit: Muttaki'eena 'alaihaa mutaqabileen
verses.translation: Reclining therein face to face.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ
verses.translit: Yatoofu 'alaihim wildaa num mukkhalladoon
verses.translation: There wait on them immortal youths
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِأَكْوَابٍۢ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۢ
verses.translit: Bi akwaabinw wa abaareeq, wa kaasim mim ma'een
verses.translation: With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ
verses.translit: Laa yusadda'oona 'anhaa wa laa yunzifoon
verses.translation: Wherefrom they get no aching of the head nor any madness,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa faakihatim mimmaa yatakhaiyaroon
verses.translation: And fruit that they prefer
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.translit: Wa lahmi tairim mimmaa yashtahoon
verses.translation: And flesh of fowls that they desire.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَحُورٌ عِينٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa hoorun'een
verses.translation: And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: كَأَمْثَٰلِ ٱللُّؤْلُؤِ ٱلْمَكْنُونِ
verses.translit: Ka amsaalil lu'lu'il maknoon
verses.translation: Like unto hidden pearls,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.translit: Jazaaa'am bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
verses.translation: Reward for what they used to do.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا
verses.translit: Laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwanw wa laa taaseemaa
verses.translation: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِلَّا قِيلًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا
verses.translit: Illaa qeelan salaaman salaamaa
verses.translation: (Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.translit: Wa as haabul yameeni maaa as haabul Yameen
verses.translation: And those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فِى سِدْرٍۢ مَّخْضُودٍۢ
verses.translit: Fee sidrim makhdood
verses.translation: Among thornless lote-trees
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَطَلْحٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa talhim mandood
verses.translation: And clustered plantains,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَظِلٍّۢ مَّمْدُودٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa zillim mamdood
verses.translation: And spreading shade,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَآءٍۢ مَّسْكُوبٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa maaa'im maskoob
verses.translation: And water gushing,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa faakihatin kaseerah
verses.translation: And fruit in plenty
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍۢ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍۢ
verses.translit: Laa maqtoo'atinw wa laa mamnoo'ah
verses.translation: Neither out of reach nor yet forbidden,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَفُرُشٍۢ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ
verses.translit: Wa furushim marfoo'ah
verses.translation: And raised couches;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءًۭ
verses.translit: Innaaa anshaanaahunna inshaaa'aa
verses.translation: Lo! We have created them a (new) creation
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا
verses.translit: Faja'alnaahunna abkaaraa
verses.translation: And made them virgins,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًۭا
verses.translit: 'Uruban atraabaa
verses.translation: Lovers, friends,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.translit: Li as haabil yameen
verses.translation: For those on the right hand;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.translit: Sullatum minal awwa leen
verses.translation: A multitude of those of old
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verses.translit: Wa sullatum minal aakhireen
verses.translation: And a multitude of those of later time.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
verses.translit: Wa as haabush shimaali maaa as haabush shimaal
verses.translation: And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فِى سَمُومٍۢ وَحَمِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Fee samoominw wa hameem
verses.translation: In scorching wind and scalding water
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَظِلٍّۢ مِّن يَحْمُومٍۢ
verses.translit: Wa zillim miny yahmoom
verses.translation: And shadow of black smoke,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّا بَارِدٍۢ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
verses.translit: Laa baaridinw wa laa kareem
verses.translation: Neither cool nor refreshing.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
verses.translit: Innaahum kaanoo qabla zaalika mutrafeen
verses.translation: Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.translit: Wa kaanoo yusirroona 'alal hinsil 'azeem
verses.translation: And used to persist in the awful sin.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
verses.translit: Wa kaanoo yaqooloona a'izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa izaaman'ainnaa lamab'oosoon
verses.translation: And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verses.translit: Awa aabaaa'unal awwaloon
verses.translation: And also our forefathers?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
verses.translit: Qul innal awwaleena wal aakhireen
verses.translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
verses.translit: Lamajmoo'oona ilaa meeqaati yawmim ma'loon
verses.translation: Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translit: summa innakum ayyuhad daaalloonal mukazziboon
verses.translation: Then lo! ye, the erring, the deniers,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَءَاكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍۢ مِّن زَقُّومٍۢ
verses.translit: La aakiloona min shaja rim min zaqqoom
verses.translation: Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
verses.translit: Famaali'oona minhal butoon
verses.translation: And will fill your bellies therewith;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَشَٰرِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.translit: Fashaariboona 'alaihi minal hameem
verses.translation: And thereon ye will drink of boiling water,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرْبَ ٱلْهِيمِ
verses.translit: Fashaariboona shurbal heem
verses.translation: Drinking even as the camel drinketh.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.translit: Haazaa nuzuluhum yawmad deen
verses.translation: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ
verses.translit: Nahnu khalaqnaakum falaw laa tusaddiqoon
verses.translation: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تُمْنُونَ
verses.translit: Afara'aytum maa tumnoon
verses.translation: Have ye seen that which ye emit?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ءَأَنتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
verses.translit: 'A-antum takhluqoo nahooo am nahnul khaaliqoon
verses.translation: Do ye create it or are We the Creator?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
verses.translit: Nahnu qaddarnaa baina kumul mawta wa maa nahnu bimasbooqeen
verses.translation: We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.translit: 'Alaaa an nubaddila amsaalakum wa nunshi'akum fee maa laa ta'lamoon
verses.translation: That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa laqad 'alimtumun nash atal oolaa falaw laa tazakkaroon
verses.translation: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَحْرُثُونَ
verses.translit: Afara'aytum maa tahrusoon
verses.translation: Have ye seen that which ye cultivate?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ءَأَنتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلزَّٰرِعُونَ
verses.translit: 'A-antum tazra'oonahooo am nahnuz zaari'ooon
verses.translation: Is it ye who foster it, or are We the Fosterer?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ حُطَٰمًۭا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ
verses.translit: Law nashaaa'u laja'al naahu hutaaman fazaltum tafakkahoon
verses.translation: If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim:
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّا لَمُغْرَمُونَ
verses.translit: Innaa lamughramoon
verses.translation: Lo! we are laden with debt!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
verses.translit: Bal nahnu mahroomoon
verses.translation: Nay, but we are deprived!
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلْمَآءَ ٱلَّذِى تَشْرَبُونَ
verses.translit: Afara'aytumul maaa'allazee tashraboon
verses.translation: Have ye observed the water which ye drink?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ
verses.translit: 'A-antum anzaltumoohu minal muzni am nahnul munziloon
verses.translation: Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَٰهُ أُجَاجًۭا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.translit: Law nashaaa'u ja'alnaahu ujaajan falaw laa tashkuroon
verses.translation: If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى تُورُونَ
verses.translit: Afara'aytumun naaral latee tooroon
verses.translation: Have ye observed the fire which ye strike out;
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ
verses.translit: 'A-antum anshaatum shajaratahaaa am nahnul munshi'oon
verses.translation: Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: نَحْنُ جَعَلْنَٰهَا تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَمَتَٰعًۭا لِّلْمُقْوِينَ
verses.translit: Nahnu ja'alnaahaa tazkira tanw wa mataa'al lilmuqween
verses.translation: We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.translit: Fasabbih bismi Rabbikal 'azeem
verses.translation: Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ۞ فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَوَٰقِعِ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.translit: Falaa uqsimu bimaawaa qi'innujoom
verses.translation: Nay, I swear by the places of the stars -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَقَسَمٌۭ لَّوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ
verses.translit: Wa innahoo laqasamul lawta'lamoona'azeem
verses.translation: And lo! that verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّهُۥ لَقُرْءَانٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Innahoo la quraanun kareem
verses.translation: That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مَّكْنُونٍۢ
verses.translit: Fee kitaabim maknoon
verses.translation: In a Book kept hidden
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ
verses.translit: Laa yamassuhooo illal mutahharoon
verses.translation: Which none toucheth save the purified,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.translit: Tanzeelum mir Rabbil'aalameen
verses.translation: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: أَفَبِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدْهِنُونَ
verses.translit: Afabihaazal hadeesi antum mudhinoon
verses.translation: Is it this Statement that ye scorn,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.translit: Wa taj'aloona rizqakum annakum tukazziboon
verses.translation: And make denial thereof your livelihood?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَوْلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلْحُلْقُومَ
verses.translit: Falaw laaa izaa balaghatil hulqoom
verses.translation: Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍۢ تَنظُرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa antum heena'izin tanzuroon
verses.translation: And ye are at that moment looking
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.translit: Wa nahnu aqrabu ilaihi minkum wa laakil laa tubsiroon
verses.translation: - And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not -
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَلَوْلَآ إِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ
verses.translit: Falaw laaa in kuntum ghira madeeneen
verses.translation: Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us),
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: تَرْجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.translit: Tarji'oonahaaa in kuntum saadiqeen
verses.translation: Do ye not force it back, if ye are truthful?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.translit: Fa ammaaa in kaana minal muqarrabeen
verses.translation: Thus if he is of those brought nigh,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَرَوْحٌۭ وَرَيْحَانٌۭ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Farawhunw wa raihaa nunw wa jannatu na'eem
verses.translation: Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.translit: Wa ammaaa in kaana min as haabil yameen
verses.translation: And if he is of those on the right hand,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَسَلَٰمٌۭ لَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.translit: Fasalaamul laka min as haabil yameen
verses.translation: Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.translit: Wa ammaaa in kaana minal mukazzibeenad daaalleen
verses.translation: But if he is of the rejecters, the erring,
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَنُزُلٌۭ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ
verses.translit: Fanuzulum min hameem
verses.translation: Then the welcome will be boiling water
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَتَصْلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ
verses.translit: Wa tasliyatu jaheem
verses.translation: And roasting at hell-fire.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
verses.translit: Inna haaza lahuwa haqqul yaqeen
verses.translation: Lo! this is certain truth.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.translit: Fasabbih bismi rabbikal 'azeem
verses.translation: Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.translit: Sabbaha lillaahi maa fissamaawaati wal ardi wa Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem
verses.translation: All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Allah; and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
verses.translit: Lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ardi yuhyee wa yumeetu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeer
verses.translation: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; He quickeneth and He giveth death; and He is Able to do all things.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْءَاخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.translit: Huwal Awwalu wal'Aakhiru waz Zaahiru wal Baatinu wa huwa bikulli shai'in Aleem
verses.translation: He is the First and the Last, and the Outward and the Inward; and He is Knower of all things.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verses.translit: Huwal lazee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda fee sittati ayyaamin summas tawaa 'alal 'Arsh; ya'lamu maa yaliju filardi wa maa yakhruju minhaa wa maa yanzilu minas samaaa'i wa maa ya'ruju feeha wa Huwa ma'akum ayna maa kuntum; wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona Baseer
verses.translation: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verses.translit: Lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ard; wa ilal laahi turja'ul umoor
verses.translation: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah (all) things are brought back.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.translit: Yoolijul laila fin nahaari wa yoolijun nahaara fil lail; wa Huwa 'Aleemum bizaatis sudoor
verses.translation: He causeth the night to pass into the day, and He causeth the day to pass into the night, and He is knower of all that is in the breasts.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
verses.translit: Aaaminoo billaahi wa Rasoolihee wa anfiqoo mimmaa ja'alakum mustakh lafeena feehi fallazeena aamanoo minkum wa anfaqoo lahum ajrun kabeer
verses.translation: Believe in Allah and His messenger, and spend of that whereof He hath made you trustees; and such of you as believe and spend (aright), theirs will be a great reward.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَٰقَكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.translit: Wa maa lakum laa tu'minoona billaahi war Rasoolu yad'ookum lituu'minoo bi Rabbikum wa qad akhaza meesaaqakum in kuntum mu'mineen
verses.translation: What aileth you that ye believe not in Allah, when the messenger calleth you to believe in your Lord, and He hath already made a covenant with you, if ye are believers?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: Huwal lazee yunazzilu 'alaa 'abdiheee Aayaatim baiyinaatil liyukhrijakum minaz zulumaati ilan noor; wa innal laaha bikum la Ra'oofur Raheem
verses.translation: He it is Who sendeth down clear revelations unto His slave, that He may bring you forth from darkness unto light; and lo! for you, Allah is Full of Pity, Merciful.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَا يَسْتَوِى مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ ٱلْفَتْحِ وَقَٰتَلَ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَقَٰتَلُوا۟ ۚ وَكُلًّۭا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ
verses.translit: Wa maa lakum allaa tunfiqoo fee sabeelil laahi wa lillaahi meeraasus samaawaati wal-ard; laa yastawee minkum man anfaqa min qablil fat-hi wa qaatal; ulaaaika a'zamu darajatam minal lazeena anfaqoo mim ba'du wa qaataloo; wa kullanw wa'adallaahul husnaa; wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona Khabeer
verses.translation: And what aileth you that ye spend not in the way of Allah when unto Allah belongeth the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent and fought before the victory are not upon a level (with the rest of you). Such are greater in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. Unto each hath Allah promised good. And Allah is Informed of what ye do.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا فَيُضَٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
verses.translit: man zal lazee yuqridul laaha qardan hasanan fa yudaa'ifahoo lahoo wa lahooo ajrun kareem
verses.translation: Who is he that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, that He may double it for him and his may be a rich reward?
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ تَرَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِم بُشْرَىٰكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.translit: Yawma taral mu'mineena walmu'minaati yas'aa nooruhum baina aydeehim wa biaymaanihim bushraakumul yawma jannaatun tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khaalideena feeha; zaalika huwal fawzul 'azeem
verses.translation: On the day when thou (Muhammad) wilt see the believers, men and women, their light shining forth before them and on their right hands, (and wilt hear it said unto them): Glad news for you this day: Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein ye are immortal. That is the supreme triumph.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran

verses.original: يَوْمَ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلْمُنَٰفِقَٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ قِيلَ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ وَرَآءَكُمْ فَٱلْتَمِسُوا۟ نُورًۭا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُم بِسُورٍۢ لَّهُۥ بَابٌۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةُ وَظَٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ
verses.translit: Yawma yaqoolul munaa fiqoona walmunaafiqaatu lillazeena aamanun zuroonaa naqtabis min noorikum qeelarji'oo waraaa'akum faltamisoo nooran faduriba bainahum bisooril lahoo baab, baatinuhoo feehir rahmatu wa zaahiruhoo min qibalihi-'azaab
verses.translation: On the day when the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women will say unto those who believe: Look on us that we may borrow from your light! it will be said: Go back and seek for light! Then there will separate them a wall wherein is a gate, the inner side whereof containeth mercy, while the outer side thereof is toward the doom.
verses.translationName: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran
